alshanex_familiars:birds_spell.name: Rhapsody
alshanex_familiars:birds_spell.desc: Summons little birds that will cheer you and your allies, giving you a little boost for some time.

alshanex_familiars:default_note.name: Chord Blast
alshanex_familiars:default_note.desc: Perform a simple melody to hurt enemies, known to be so catchy that people can't get away from it.

alshanex_familiars:end_mayhem.name: End's Mayhem
alshanex_familiars:end_mayhem.desc: This spell allows you to become the ruler of the end while casting it, allowing you to use the full power of the end dimension to kill your target.

alshanex_familiars:explosion_melody.name: Grand Finale
alshanex_familiars:explosion_melody.desc: Performs an outrageous melody that traps the enemies and annihilates them with an explosive climax.

alshanex_familiars:fire_fist.name: Fire Fist
alshanex_familiars:fire_fist.desc: Strike with a powerful fire fist burning everything in the way.

alshanex_familiars:guardian_angel.name: Celestial Chant
alshanex_familiars:guardian_angel.desc: Calls the angels to play an angelic melody that will heal and protect you and your allies.

alshanex_familiars:harp_symphony.name: Crescendo
alshanex_familiars:harp_symphony.desc: Performs a rumbling melody that hurts and stuns the enemy.

alshanex_familiars:ice_age.name: Ice Age
alshanex_familiars:ice_age.desc: Freeze everything around you, covering the world in ice.

alshanex_familiars:ice_chamber.name: Ice Chamber
alshanex_familiars:ice_chamber.desc: Shoot a freezing ray that will freeze an area around the impact and sometimes even the enemy itself.

alshanex_familiars:lullaby.name: Serenade
alshanex_familiars:lullaby.desc: Start playing a slow-paced, harmonious melody to make your enemies sleepy.

alshanex_familiars:megido.name: Electric Rain
alshanex_familiars:megido.desc: Summon the wrath of the heavens, striking with lightnings every entity that dares to come around.

alshanex_familiars:music_bolt.name: Clef
alshanex_familiars:music_bolt.desc: Shoots a simple note towards the enemy.

alshanex_familiars:sonata.name: Sonata
alshanex_familiars:sonata.desc: Start playing a fast-paced song for everyone to hear, an harmonious melody to hurt your enemies.

alshanex_familiars:summon_shadows.name: Call the Shadows
alshanex_familiars:summon_shadows.desc: Call shadow knights into your world, they are invulnerable and will pursue the enemy relentlessly.

antimagic:anti_magic_slash.name: Anti-Magic Slash
antimagic:anti_magic_slash.desc: Releases a blade of Anti-Magic that flies forward, dealing damage, purging buffs, and obliterating enemy spells in its path.

antimagic:black_mantle.name: Anti-Magic Shroud
antimagic:black_mantle.desc: Channels a 2-second cast bar to shroud yourself in Anti-Magic, gaining Speed and a Black Glowing aura for 30 seconds at the cost of 1 hunger drumstick.

antimagic:black_ward.name: Black Ward
antimagic:black_ward.desc: Unleashes an explosive dome of Anti-Magic that destroys all incoming hostile projectiles, knocks back and silences nearby enemies, and grants the caster temporary damage resistance.

antimagic:demonic_assimilation.name: Demonic Assimilation (Phase 1)
antimagic:demonic_assimilation.desc: Channels the power of the anti-magic demon, granting superhuman strength, speed, resistance, and flight.

antimagic:summon_demon_destroyer.name: Summon Demon-Destroyer Sword
antimagic:summon_demon_destroyer.desc: Manifests or toggles the Demon-Destroyer Sword in your main hand.

antimagic:summon_demon_dweller.name: Summon Demon-Dweller Sword
antimagic:summon_demon_dweller.desc: Manifests or toggles the Demon-Dweller Sword in your main hand.

antimagic:summon_demon_slayer.name: Summon Demon-Slayer Sword
antimagic:summon_demon_slayer.desc: Manifests or toggles the Demon-Slayer Sword in your main hand.

antimagic:sword_call.name: Sword Recall
antimagic:sword_call.desc: Calls all of your thrown Anti-Magic swords flying at high speed through the air directly to you.

cursed_school:apostate_crown.name: Apostate Crown
cursed_school:apostate_crown.desc: Don a crown mode for power or shell, paid upfront with +20 Corruption. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.

cursed_school:ash_guard.name: Ash Guard
cursed_school:ash_guard.desc: Wraps you in an ash shell that blocks incoming projectiles.

cursed_school:ash_needle.name: Ash Needle
cursed_school:ash_needle.desc: Fires a piercing ash needle that applies Rot Stack on contact.

cursed_school:ash_pack.name: Ash Pack
cursed_school:ash_pack.desc: Summon ash hounds that bite with Wither for 10 minutes.

cursed_school:black_root.name: Black Root
cursed_school:black_root.desc: Hard-roots a foe in place under heavy wither pressure.

cursed_school:black_verse.name: Black Verse
cursed_school:black_verse.desc: Raises an anti-magic domain that stifles spellcasting nearby.

cursed_school:blight_step.name: Blight Step
cursed_school:blight_step.desc: Blink a short distance, leaving rot puddles at both start and landing.

cursed_school:bone_toll.name: Bone Toll
cursed_school:bone_toll.desc: Strikes and banks Toll Marks you can cash later (up to five).

cursed_school:call_clerk.name: Call Clerk
cursed_school:call_clerk.desc: Summon an Inkbound Clerk that stamps Corruption Brand on hit.

cursed_school:chain_of_remorse.name: Chain of Remorse
cursed_school:chain_of_remorse.desc: Links a primary target to nearby foes so pulsed damage chains between them.

cursed_school:choir_of_flies.name: Choir of Flies
cursed_school:choir_of_flies.desc: Steers a biting fly swarm along your look cone.

cursed_school:crow_feast.name: Crow Feast
cursed_school:crow_feast.desc: Sends a flurry of pecks; landing enough blinds the victim.

cursed_school:debt_spike.name: Debt Spike
cursed_school:debt_spike.desc: Spikes a foe for Corruption-scaled damage. Against mobs, also applies an Owed DoT; other players never gain Corruption or Owed.

cursed_school:decay_field.name: Decay Field
cursed_school:decay_field.desc: Leaves a decaying trail under your feet that damages those who linger.

cursed_school:eclipse_maw.name: Eclipse Maw
cursed_school:eclipse_maw.desc: Pulls enemies inward, then crushes them in an eclipse maw.

cursed_school:finished_margin.name: Finished Margin
cursed_school:finished_margin.desc: Domain pulse that executes branded foes below a quarter health. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.

cursed_school:grave_dust.name: Grave Dust
cursed_school:grave_dust.desc: Bursts a lingering dust cloud that keeps choking enemies for a few seconds.

cursed_school:greedy_margin.name: Greedy Margin
cursed_school:greedy_margin.desc: Discounts your next Cursed casts' mana cost while adding extra Corruption each time.

cursed_school:hatch_cysts.name: Hatch Cysts
cursed_school:hatch_cysts.desc: Hatch a swarm of Cyst Mites that stack Rot for 20 minutes.

cursed_school:hex_barrage.name: Hex Barrage
cursed_school:hex_barrage.desc: Plants Hex Seals on foes in a look-cone without detonating them.

cursed_school:hollow_bite.name: Hollow Bite
cursed_school:hollow_bite.desc: Devours held food into mana, with unclean foods granting a larger restore.

cursed_school:invoice.name: Invoice
cursed_school:invoice.desc: Marks a trap invoice that detonates when the victim casts or heals.

cursed_school:issue_invoice.name: Issue Invoice
cursed_school:issue_invoice.desc: Summon a skeletal collector whose arrows shred armor.

cursed_school:leech_thread.name: Leech Thread
cursed_school:leech_thread.desc: Channels a siphon thread that heals you and restores mana each tick.

cursed_school:margin_pact.name: Margin Pact
cursed_school:margin_pact.desc: Self-buff pact that strengthens you while taxing +1 Corruption for the duration.

cursed_school:marrow_drain.name: Marrow Drain
cursed_school:marrow_drain.desc: Drains marrow for damage, wounding the target while granting you Absorption.

cursed_school:night_ledger.name: Night Ledger
cursed_school:night_ledger.desc: Opens the night ledger: stronger Cursed power in darkness than in bright day.

cursed_school:pale_lantern.name: Pale Lantern
cursed_school:pale_lantern.desc: Reveals hostiles with Glowing and burns undead with ongoing pale light.

cursed_school:rot_bolt.name: Rot Bolt
cursed_school:rot_bolt.desc: Embeds a Rot Cyst on hit, or pops an existing cyst into contagious spores.

cursed_school:rotting_rain.name: Rotting Rain
cursed_school:rotting_rain.desc: Calls a storm of wither rain that stacks Rot on everything beneath it.

cursed_school:ruin_slash.name: Ruin Slash
cursed_school:ruin_slash.desc: Cone slash that shreds armor on up to five enemies in front of you.

cursed_school:severed_tithe.name: Severed Tithe
cursed_school:severed_tithe.desc: Heavy strike that refunds mana and healing if it kills.

cursed_school:soot_shroud.name: Soot Shroud
cursed_school:soot_shroud.desc: Cloaks you in soot stealth; breaking the shroud amplifies your next hit.

cursed_school:stain_brand.name: Corruption Brand
cursed_school:stain_brand.desc: Brands a target for execute synergy and Finished Margin domain kills.

cursed_school:testament_of_ash.name: Testament of Ash
cursed_school:testament_of_ash.desc: Nova of ash that seals the ground afterward. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.

cursed_school:thrice_signed_name.name: Thrice-Signed Name
cursed_school:thrice_signed_name.desc: Fires a triple raycast burst that echoes your signed name. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page.

cursed_school:umbral_coffin.name: Umbral Coffin
cursed_school:umbral_coffin.desc: Cages a target in an immobilizing umbral coffin.

cursed_school:unsigned_judgment.name: Unsigned Judgment
cursed_school:unsigned_judgment.desc: Call a Margin Wither for 30 minutes. Legendary — learn via Unsigned Page. Requires Corruption 80000+.

cursed_school:wailing_dirge.name: Wailing Dirge
cursed_school:wailing_dirge.desc: Fear cone that punishes enemies who try to flee the dirge.

cursed_school:withering_touch.name: Withering Touch
cursed_school:withering_touch.desc: Melee touch that withers the target and deals bonus damage against already-withered foes.

esoteric_spell:aegis_barrier.name: Aegis Barrier
esoteric_spell:aegis_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that reduces magic damage for allies inside it.

esoteric_spell:array_device.name: Device: Array
esoteric_spell:array_device.desc: Each device independently finds a target, teleports above it and periodically fires a beam.

esoteric_spell:aspis_soul_barrier.name: Aspis Soul Barrier
esoteric_spell:aspis_soul_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that grants allies Aspis Soul, reducing incoming damage.

esoteric_spell:auto_arrow_magic.name: Auto Arrow Magic
esoteric_spell:auto_arrow_magic.desc: Creates an Auto Arrow magic circle over the caster. The circle fires piercing barrier arrows at the locked target once per second.

esoteric_spell:auto_device.name: Auto Device
esoteric_spell:auto_device.desc: Summons automatic arcane devices that follow behind you in a ring formation.

esoteric_spell:auto_javelin_magic.name: Auto Javelin Magic
esoteric_spell:auto_javelin_magic.desc: Creates an Auto Javelin magic circle over the caster. The circle fires larger piercing barrier javelins at the locked target every 1.5 seconds.

esoteric_spell:auto_lances_magic.name: Auto Lances Magic
esoteric_spell:auto_lances_magic.desc: Creates an Auto Lances magic circle over the caster. The circle fires piercing barrier lances at the locked target every 2 seconds.

esoteric_spell:barrier_aura.name: Barrier Aura
esoteric_spell:barrier_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that grants Protection to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:blast_magic.name: Blast
esoteric_spell:blast_magic.desc: Must target an entity. Channels magical energy at the target, then detonates in a planar splash.

esoteric_spell:bless_barrier.name: Bless Barrier
esoteric_spell:bless_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that heals allies every 0.5 seconds.

esoteric_spell:brave_aura.name: Brave Aura
esoteric_spell:brave_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that grants Brave to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:cannon_magic.name: Magic Cannon
esoteric_spell:cannon_magic.desc: The first cast opens a charge window. Casting again fires a golden energy beam. Each activation is handled as a single-stage spell. Charging cannot be copied, while firing can be copied by Symphony, Chronos Shift, and Origin Devices.

esoteric_spell:cast_barrier.name: Cast Barrier
esoteric_spell:cast_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that continuously grants the Iron's Spells Haste status to the caster and their summons, boosting movement, attack and cast speed.

esoteric_spell:chase_device.name: Device: Chase
esoteric_spell:chase_device.desc: Commands automatic devices to fire chase beams after you deal Esoteric spell damage.

esoteric_spell:chronos_shift_magic.name: Chronos Shift Magic
esoteric_spell:chronos_shift_magic.desc: Copies the last Esoteric spell cast recently. Familiar, aura, barrier and excluded spells are not copied.

esoteric_spell:counter_device.name: Device: Counter
esoteric_spell:counter_device.desc: Commands automatic devices to counterattack enemies that damage allies within range.

esoteric_spell:crash_magic.name: Crash Magic
esoteric_spell:crash_magic.desc: Calls down fast crash meteors at the target position. Symphony can copy this spell.

esoteric_spell:cycle_aura.name: Cycle Aura
esoteric_spell:cycle_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that grants Cycle to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:dual_bringer.name: Magic Blade: Dual Bringer
esoteric_spell:dual_bringer.desc: Clears the previous conversion when channeling starts. On completion, excess spell power becomes attack damage and attack damage becomes spell power; the calculated values remain fixed until expiration.

esoteric_spell:echanted_burst.name: Magic Blade: Enchanted Burst
esoteric_spell:echanted_burst.desc: Bursts the locked target and grants Magic Blade Enhancement, increasing Enchant Slash and Element Slash damage by 25%.

esoteric_spell:echanted_spell.name: Magic Blade: Enchanted Spell
esoteric_spell:echanted_spell.desc: Successful weapon hits lock the target and instantly cast Auto Arrow, Auto Javelin, Auto Lances, Blast, or Storm at random without mana cost. All five share one trigger cooldown.

esoteric_spell:element_slash.name: Magic Blade: Element Slash
esoteric_spell:element_slash.desc: Launches a slower slash along the view direction. Damage benefits from current attack damage and main-hand enchantments, but cannot trigger Conversion or Enchanting.

esoteric_spell:esoteric_missile.name: Esoteric Missile
esoteric_spell:esoteric_missile.desc: Launch an Esoteric Missile and gain Esoteric Technique.

esoteric_spell:esoteric_shackle.name: Esoteric Shackles
esoteric_spell:esoteric_shackle.desc: After charging, bind non-allied entities in the targeted area; each shackle can be destroyed independently.

esoteric_spell:esoteric_step.name: Esoteric Step
esoteric_spell:esoteric_step.desc: Teleports toward the aimed position after channeling. A destination beyond the maximum range is clamped along the same direction.

esoteric_spell:ether_barrier.name: Ether Barrier
esoteric_spell:ether_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that grants allies Ether, increasing knockback resistance, movement speed and cast speed.

esoteric_spell:familia_blizzard.name: Familia: Blizzard
esoteric_spell:familia_blizzard.desc: Commands an existing familiar to channel a blizzard at the target position, pulling and damaging enemies inside it.

esoteric_spell:familia_cat_summon.name: Familia: Black Cat
esoteric_spell:familia_cat_summon.desc: Summons a black cat familiar at the target position. While present, it grants its owner Familia: Black Cat.

esoteric_spell:familia_imperial_ray.name: Familia: Imperial Ray
esoteric_spell:familia_imperial_ray.desc: Commands an existing familiar to summon a descending imperial ray that damages enemies it touches.

esoteric_spell:familia_lightning.name: Familia: Lightning
esoteric_spell:familia_lightning.desc: Commands an existing familiar to strike the target location with lightning.

esoteric_spell:familia_meteor.name: Familia: Meteor
esoteric_spell:familia_meteor.desc: Commands an existing familiar to call down meteors at the target location.

esoteric_spell:familia_research.name: Familia: Research
esoteric_spell:familia_research.desc: Grants Magic Circuit, reducing familiar cast time and increasing damage dealt by familiar spells.

esoteric_spell:familia_symphony.name: Familia: Symphony
esoteric_spell:familia_symphony.desc: Grants Spell Symphony. While active, familiars have a chance to copy some Esoteric spells with the Magic prefix.

esoteric_spell:fast_reaction_aura.name: Fast Reaction Aura
esoteric_spell:fast_reaction_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that gives allies a chance to dodge incoming attacks. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:finale_guide.name: Familia: Guide
esoteric_spell:finale_guide.desc: Commands your familiar to gain Guide, letting it automatically channel Lightning, Blizzard or Meteor while idle.

esoteric_spell:finale_magic.name: Finale Magic
esoteric_spell:finale_magic.desc: Marks three concentric circles, then raises three vertical beams from the center in sequence.

esoteric_spell:finale_mana_regan.name: Familia: Mana Feedback
esoteric_spell:finale_mana_regan.desc: Commands your familiar to gain Mana Feedback, restoring mana to its owner when familiar spells finish.

esoteric_spell:finale_stone_barrier.name: Familia: Stone Skin
esoteric_spell:finale_stone_barrier.desc: Commands your familiar to channel Stone Skin, converting shield absorption into effect duration.

esoteric_spell:flowing_barrier.name: Flowing Barrier
esoteric_spell:flowing_barrier.desc: While channeling and while the effect lasts, sourced damage is reduced and restores mana based on its original amount.

esoteric_spell:gloria_barrier.name: Gloria Barrier
esoteric_spell:gloria_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that grants allies Gloria, increasing armor and armor toughness.

esoteric_spell:guandian_beam_magic.name: Guandian Beam Magic
esoteric_spell:guandian_beam_magic.desc: Creates a light-guard barrier. Barrier-school spell casts inside it can fire guiding beam projectiles at hostile targets.

esoteric_spell:guard_barrier.name: Guard Barrier
esoteric_spell:guard_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that absorbs damage for you and your allies.

esoteric_spell:guardian_barrier.name: Guardian Barrier
esoteric_spell:guardian_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that grants Guarding to its caster and redirects enemies targeting allies inside it.

esoteric_spell:health_aura.name: Health Aura
esoteric_spell:health_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that heals allies every second and grants Energy Aura to the caster. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:immunity_aura.name: Immunity Aura
esoteric_spell:immunity_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that has a chance every 2 seconds to cleanse one random non-beneficial effect from each ally. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:impact_magic.name: Impact Shock
esoteric_spell:impact_magic.desc: Unleashes a shockwave that damages enemies and knocks them back with force increasing with distance.

esoteric_spell:laser_magic.name: Laser Magic
esoteric_spell:laser_magic.desc: Fires a sequence of esoteric lasers. When copied by Symphony, it fires once every 0.5 seconds until all shots are spent.

esoteric_spell:limit_break.name: Limit Break
esoteric_spell:limit_break.desc: Grants Limit Break. Each level grants 2.5% spell power and 5% cast-time and cooldown reduction.

esoteric_spell:magic_blade_absorb.name: Magic Blade: Absorb
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_absorb.desc: Successful weapon hits restore mana while the effect lasts. The restored amount scales with spell and Esoteric spell power.

esoteric_spell:magic_blade_conversion.name: Magic Blade: Conversion
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_conversion.desc: After a weapon successfully hits, consumes mana to convert part of the wielder's attack damage into Esoteric spell damage. Conversion and Enchanting can both trigger.

esoteric_spell:magic_blade_enchant_slash.name: Magic Blade: Enchant Slash
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_enchant_slash.desc: Slashes forward. Conversion and Enchanting effects each add a separate hit at 50% of their normal damage.

esoteric_spell:magic_blade_enchanting.name: Magic Blade: Enchanting
esoteric_spell:magic_blade_enchanting.desc: After a weapon successfully hits, adds Esoteric spell damage based on that weapon's displayed attack damage without consuming extra mana.

esoteric_spell:magic_skin.name: Magic Skin
esoteric_spell:magic_skin.desc: Reduces damage according to current mana percentage without consuming mana. More remaining mana provides more reduction.

esoteric_spell:mana_aura.name: Mana Aura
esoteric_spell:mana_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that restores mana to allied players every second and grants Energy Aura to the caster. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:mana_change_barrier.name: Mana Change Barrier
esoteric_spell:mana_change_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that restores mana to allies in range instantly and every second thereafter.

esoteric_spell:mana_resonance.name: Mana Resonance
esoteric_spell:mana_resonance.desc: Balances your current health and mana ratios, then grants Mana Resonance.

esoteric_spell:maximizer_change_barrier.name: Maximizer Change Barrier
esoteric_spell:maximizer_change_barrier.desc: Instantly cancels your own Mana Change Barrier and injects the remaining mana to be restored into allies in range (cast inside a Rapid Change Barrier for Full Mana).

esoteric_spell:missile_device.name: Device: Missile
esoteric_spell:missile_device.desc: Commands automatic devices to periodically fire magic missiles at nearby hostile targets.

esoteric_spell:namesis_magic.name: Namesis Magic
esoteric_spell:namesis_magic.desc: The first cast accumulates Namesis levels and cannot be copied. The second cast requires a target and can be copied by Symphony, Chronos Shift, and Origin Devices; copied Namesis barriers are independent.

esoteric_spell:prayer_barrier.name: Prayer Barrier
esoteric_spell:prayer_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that grants allies Prayer, increasing spell power.

esoteric_spell:protection_barrier.name: Protection Barrier
esoteric_spell:protection_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that reduces non-magic incoming damage for allies inside it.

esoteric_spell:qadal_magic.name: Qadal Magic
esoteric_spell:qadal_magic.desc: Grants Qadal. Your next Esoteric spell consumes extra mana, gains stronger spell-power scaling, and adds mana overload.

esoteric_spell:quick_motion_aura.name: Quick Motion Aura
esoteric_spell:quick_motion_aura.desc: Creates a moving aura that grants Quick Motion to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

esoteric_spell:rapid_change_barrier.name: Rapid Change Barrier
esoteric_spell:rapid_change_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier where casting Mana Change Barrier boosts per-second mana restore by 20%, and casting Maximizer Change Barrier grants allies the Full Mana status.

esoteric_spell:resurrection.name: Resurrection
esoteric_spell:resurrection.desc: Records Resurrection data for the caster and nearby allies. Consumed to prevent death; Stasis damage or a Stasis effect prevents activation.

esoteric_spell:sanctuary_barrier.name: Sanctuary Barrier
esoteric_spell:sanctuary_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that reduces small damage hits taken by allies inside it.

esoteric_spell:spell_calibration.name: Spell Calibration
esoteric_spell:spell_calibration.desc: Grants Spell Calibration. Esoteric spell damage reduces the target's invulnerability time by 20% per level.

esoteric_spell:storm_magic.name: Storm Magic
esoteric_spell:storm_magic.desc: Creates a stationary storm at the target location, pulling enemies inward and damaging them every second.

esoteric_spell:suppress_device.name: Device: Suppression
esoteric_spell:suppress_device.desc: Devices track the locked target, fire several rapid suppression volleys, then resume their prior command.

esoteric_spell:union_sword.name: Magic Blade: Union Sword
esoteric_spell:union_sword.desc: Requires more than 15 seconds of Magic Blade Enhancement. Releases a horizontal slash and consumes 15 seconds, then consumes up to 15 more seconds and releases a vertical slash after 0.5 seconds.

esoteric_spell:vulcan_device.name: Device: Vulcan
esoteric_spell:vulcan_device.desc: Selects up to five targets. Selected devices vanish, appear above their targets, then fire heavy Vulcan beams in sequence.

esoteric_spell:wall_barrier.name: Wall Barrier
esoteric_spell:wall_barrier.desc: Creates a barrier that damages and repels hostile mobs targeting you or your allies; projectiles not fired by you or your summons are forced to the ground.

irons_chronomancy:body_rewind.name: Body Rewind
irons_chronomancy:body_rewind.desc: First cast records your position, health and hunger. Cast again before the anchor expires to return; expiry only removes the anchor. Legendary can consume a safe anchor to prevent death. Inventory, mana, cooldowns and world state are never rolled back.

irons_chronomancy:borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
irons_chronomancy:borrowed_time.desc: Accelerates movement and ongoing health/mana regeneration for six seconds, then locks movement for two seconds. The approaching lock is signalled in advance. Reconnecting or changing dimension cannot erase the payback.

irons_chronomancy:chronal_bolt.name: Chronal Bolt
irons_chronomancy:chronal_bolt.desc: Fires a focused temporal lance at the target.

irons_chronomancy:chrono_step.name: Chrono Step
irons_chronomancy:chrono_step.desc: Steps safely along your aim and leaves a player-sized, two-HP temporal decoy for two seconds. Only hostiles already pursuing you may switch to it. The step cannot pass through blocked body space.

irons_chronomancy:dilated_zone.name: Dilated Zone
irons_chronomancy:dilated_zone.desc: Creates a fixed zone that slows eligible living entities and projectiles, including supported flying and custom movement. The caster is immune to their own zone. Higher levels improve coverage and lifetime.

irons_chronomancy:paradox.name: Paradox
irons_chronomancy:paradox.desc: Marks one enemy for three temporal strikes, each based on its maximum health. Highest level: 7% per strike, 21% total before legitimate mitigation. Ordinary spell-power bonuses cannot amplify that percentage. No splash damage.

irons_chronomancy:prepared_cut_back.name: Prepared Cut Back
irons_chronomancy:prepared_cut_back.desc: Sneak-cast to restore yourself, or aim at an ally without sneaking. Restores 40% of maximum health and up to eight food points for players. Hostile targets cannot be healed. Higher levels improve reach and mana efficiency.

irons_chronomancy:slowdown.name: Slowdown
irons_chronomancy:slowdown.desc: Slows an eligible enemy and its temporal movement. Downward marks and slow clock hands distinguish it from Speedup. Higher levels improve duration, range and slowing strength.

irons_chronomancy:speedup.name: Speedup
irons_chronomancy:speedup.desc: Sneak to accelerate yourself. Otherwise, aim at a teammate, owned companion or clearly friendly creature; with no friendly target, you accelerate yourself. Hostile enemies are never accelerated. Temporal movement and upward clock marks distinguish the positive effect; higher levels improve duration, reach and strength.

irons_chronomancy:stasis.name: Stasis
irons_chronomancy:stasis.desc: Suspends one eligible target in time. A frozen clock marks the effect; normal movement resumes afterwards. Higher levels improve duration and reach. Scripted boss immunity and PvP restrictions are respected.

irons_chronomancy:target_rewind.name: Target Rewind
irons_chronomancy:target_rewind.desc: First cast marks one eligible entity and its current position. The second cast returns that same entity, not a new target. The native return timer and world echo show the active mark. Health is unchanged; expiry never teleports automatically.

irons_chronomancy:temporal_anchors.name: Temporal Anchors
irons_chronomancy:temporal_anchors.desc: Retired compatibility entry. Existing worlds, scrolls and books remain readable, but this ability cannot be cast or obtained. Use Body Rewind or Target Rewind.

irons_chronomancy:temporal_wall.name: Temporal Wall
irons_chronomancy:temporal_wall.desc: Raises a translucent temporal barrier. Eligible hostile creatures and projectiles cannot simply cross it; the caster and permitted allies remain free. Higher levels widen and heighten the wall without making it opaque.

irons_chronomancy:time_debt.name: Time Debt
irons_chronomancy:time_debt.desc: For 30 seconds, take 50% of incoming mitigated damage immediately and borrow the other half. Over the following 30 seconds, repay 70% of that debt in six payments, five seconds apart. New damage is normal during repayment. Reconnecting pauses, but never erases, the debt.

irons_chronomancy:time_stop.name: Time Stop
irons_chronomancy:time_stop.desc: Suspends eligible creatures and moving entities inside a local field, including Creeper fuses and projectiles. The caster and their own projectiles remain free. Boss exceptions and PvP rules still apply; world time and cooldowns continue.

irons_spellbooks:abyssal_shroud.name: Abyssal Shroud
irons_spellbooks:abyssal_shroud.desc: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.

irons_spellbooks:acid_orb.name: Acid Spit
irons_spellbooks:acid_orb.desc: Spit an orb of acid, splashing in a radius upon impact and rending creatures hit, melting away and reducing their armor

irons_spellbooks:acupuncture.name: Acupuncture
irons_spellbooks:acupuncture.desc: Around a targeted creature, create a field of blood needles in every direction, shooting down and healing you for 25% of damage done

irons_spellbooks:angel_wing.name: Angel Wings
irons_spellbooks:angel_wing.desc: Cast to gain wings made of holy energy, acting as an elytra, for a brief period of time.

irons_spellbooks:arcane_shackle.name: Arcane Shackle
irons_spellbooks:arcane_shackle.desc: Hurl a bundle of arcane chains. Upon hitting a creature, cause three chains to bind it to the ground, each applying a tethering force. On miss, three chains lash out to unique nearby creatures. Chains can be damaged or dispelled.

irons_spellbooks:arrow_volley.name: Arrow Volley
irons_spellbooks:arrow_volley.desc: Around a targeted creature or block, summon a rolling wave of magical arrows from the sky.

irons_spellbooks:ascension.name: Ascension
irons_spellbooks:ascension.desc: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.

irons_spellbooks:ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
irons_spellbooks:ball_lightning.desc: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.

irons_spellbooks:black_hole.name: Black Hole
irons_spellbooks:black_hole.desc: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death

irons_spellbooks:blaze_storm.name: Blaze Storm
irons_spellbooks:blaze_storm.desc: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.

irons_spellbooks:blessing_of_life.name: Blessing of Life
irons_spellbooks:blessing_of_life.desc: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.

irons_spellbooks:blight.name: Blight
irons_spellbooks:blight.desc: Target a creature to blight them, reducing their incoming healing and outgoing damage

irons_spellbooks:blizzard.name: Blizzard
irons_spellbooks:blizzard.desc: Channel a slow-moving, swirling blizzard at a targeted location, causing freezing wind and snow to pull creatures into the center of the vortex.

irons_spellbooks:blood_needles.name: Blood Needles
irons_spellbooks:blood_needles.desc: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done

irons_spellbooks:blood_slash.name: Blood Slash
irons_spellbooks:blood_slash.desc: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of blood, slicing through creatures and healing for 15% of damage done.

irons_spellbooks:blood_step.name: Blood Step
irons_spellbooks:blood_step.desc: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.

irons_spellbooks:burning_dash.name: Burning Dash
irons_spellbooks:burning_dash.desc: Quickly launch yourself forward in a haze of fire, searing creatures you pass through while in a blaze.

irons_spellbooks:chain_creeper.name: Chain Creeper
irons_spellbooks:chain_creeper.desc: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.

irons_spellbooks:chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
irons_spellbooks:chain_lightning.desc: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures

irons_spellbooks:charge.name: Charge
irons_spellbooks:charge.desc: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.

irons_spellbooks:cleanse.name: Cleanse
irons_spellbooks:cleanse.desc: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.

irons_spellbooks:cloud_of_regeneration.name: Cloud of Regeneration
irons_spellbooks:cloud_of_regeneration.desc: Hold to slowly heal friendly creatures within a radius around you.

irons_spellbooks:cone_of_cold.name: Cone of Cold
irons_spellbooks:cone_of_cold.desc: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:counterspell.name: Counterspell
irons_spellbooks:counterspell.desc: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.

irons_spellbooks:devour.name: Devour
irons_spellbooks:devour.desc: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.

irons_spellbooks:divine_smite.name: Divine Smite
irons_spellbooks:divine_smite.desc: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

irons_spellbooks:dragon_breath.name: Dragon's Breath
irons_spellbooks:dragon_breath.desc: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.

irons_spellbooks:earthquake.name: Earthquake
irons_spellbooks:earthquake.desc: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.

irons_spellbooks:echoing_strikes.name: Echoing Strikes
irons_spellbooks:echoing_strikes.desc: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.

irons_spellbooks:eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
irons_spellbooks:eldritch_blast.desc: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.

irons_spellbooks:electrocute.name: Electrocute
irons_spellbooks:electrocute.desc: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:evasion.name: Evasion
irons_spellbooks:evasion.desc: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.

irons_spellbooks:fang_strike.name: Fang Strike
irons_spellbooks:fang_strike.desc: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.

irons_spellbooks:fang_swirl.name: Fang Swirl
irons_spellbooks:fang_swirl.desc: Target a creature or block to conjure a spiraling zone of evoker fangs in a radius.

irons_spellbooks:fang_ward.name: Fang Ward
irons_spellbooks:fang_ward.desc: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.

irons_spellbooks:fire_arrow.name: Fire Arrow
irons_spellbooks:fire_arrow.desc: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.

irons_spellbooks:fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
irons_spellbooks:fire_breath.desc: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.

irons_spellbooks:fireball.name: Fireball
irons_spellbooks:fireball.desc: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.

irons_spellbooks:firebolt.name: Firebolt
irons_spellbooks:firebolt.desc: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits.

irons_spellbooks:firecracker.name: Firecracker
irons_spellbooks:firecracker.desc: Instantaneously conjure a firework where you look that explodes in a small radius around it.

irons_spellbooks:firefly_swarm.name: Firefly Swarm
irons_spellbooks:firefly_swarm.desc: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.

irons_spellbooks:flaming_barrage.name: Flaming Barrage
irons_spellbooks:flaming_barrage.desc: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.

irons_spellbooks:flaming_strike.name: Flaming Strike
irons_spellbooks:flaming_strike.desc: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

irons_spellbooks:fortify.name: Fortify
irons_spellbooks:fortify.desc: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.

irons_spellbooks:frost_step.name: Frost Step
irons_spellbooks:frost_step.desc: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

irons_spellbooks:frostbite.name: Frostbite
irons_spellbooks:frostbite.desc: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

irons_spellbooks:frostwave.name: Frostwave
irons_spellbooks:frostwave.desc: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

irons_spellbooks:gluttony.name: Gluttony
irons_spellbooks:gluttony.desc: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:gravity_fissure.name: Gravity Fissure
irons_spellbooks:gravity_fissure.desc: Split from the air a miniature Black Hole that moves forward in a line, pulling nearby creatures into its gravity well, but dealing no damage.

irons_spellbooks:greater_heal.name: Greater Heal
irons_spellbooks:greater_heal.desc: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.

irons_spellbooks:guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
irons_spellbooks:guiding_bolt.desc: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them

irons_spellbooks:gust.name: Gust
irons_spellbooks:gust.desc: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall

irons_spellbooks:haste.name: Haste
irons_spellbooks:haste.desc: To a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:heal.name: Heal
irons_spellbooks:heal.desc: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health.

irons_spellbooks:healing_circle.name: Healing Circle
irons_spellbooks:healing_circle.desc: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within

irons_spellbooks:heartstop.name: Heartstop
irons_spellbooks:heartstop.desc: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.

irons_spellbooks:heat_surge.name: Heat Surge
irons_spellbooks:heat_surge.desc: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.

irons_spellbooks:ice_block.name: Ice Block
irons_spellbooks:ice_block.desc: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.

irons_spellbooks:ice_spikes.name: Ice Spikes
irons_spellbooks:ice_spikes.desc: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.

irons_spellbooks:ice_tomb.name: Ice Tomb
irons_spellbooks:ice_tomb.desc: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.

irons_spellbooks:icicle.name: Icicle
irons_spellbooks:icicle.desc: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches.

irons_spellbooks:invisibility.name: Invisibility
irons_spellbooks:invisibility.desc: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.

irons_spellbooks:lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
irons_spellbooks:lightning_bolt.desc: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.

irons_spellbooks:lightning_lance.name: Lightning Lance
irons_spellbooks:lightning_lance.desc: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.

irons_spellbooks:lob_creeper.name: Lob Creeper
irons_spellbooks:lob_creeper.desc: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

irons_spellbooks:magic_arrow.name: Magic Arrow
irons_spellbooks:magic_arrow.desc: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.

irons_spellbooks:magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
irons_spellbooks:magic_missile.desc: Shoot a bolt of concentrated arcane magic. Also a trademark of every wizard.

irons_spellbooks:magma_bomb.name: Magma Bomb
irons_spellbooks:magma_bomb.desc: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands

irons_spellbooks:oakskin.name: Oakskin
irons_spellbooks:oakskin.desc: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:planar_sight.name: Planar Sight
irons_spellbooks:planar_sight.desc: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.

irons_spellbooks:pocket_dimension.name: Pocket Dimension
irons_spellbooks:pocket_dimension.desc: Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.

irons_spellbooks:poison_arrow.name: Poison Arrow
irons_spellbooks:poison_arrow.desc: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact

irons_spellbooks:poison_breath.name: Poison Spray
irons_spellbooks:poison_breath.desc: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach

irons_spellbooks:poison_splash.name: Poison Splash
irons_spellbooks:poison_splash.desc: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud

irons_spellbooks:portal.name: Portal
irons_spellbooks:portal.desc: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.

irons_spellbooks:raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
irons_spellbooks:raise_dead.desc: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.

irons_spellbooks:raise_hell.name: Raise Hell
irons_spellbooks:raise_hell.desc: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.

irons_spellbooks:ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
irons_spellbooks:ray_of_frost.desc: Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.

irons_spellbooks:ray_of_siphoning.name: Ray of Siphoning
irons_spellbooks:ray_of_siphoning.desc: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.

irons_spellbooks:recall.name: Recall
irons_spellbooks:recall.desc: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.

irons_spellbooks:root.name: Root
irons_spellbooks:root.desc: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement

irons_spellbooks:sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
irons_spellbooks:sacrifice.desc: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.

irons_spellbooks:scapegoat.name: Scapegoat
irons_spellbooks:scapegoat.desc: Conjure a magical decoy in the form of a goat, which takes aggro from nearby hostile mobs and runs off into the distance, taunting them for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:scorch.name: Scorch
irons_spellbooks:scorch.desc: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.

irons_spellbooks:sculk_tentacles.name: Sculk Tentacles
irons_spellbooks:sculk_tentacles.desc: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.

irons_spellbooks:shadow_slash.name: Shadow Slash
irons_spellbooks:shadow_slash.desc: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

irons_spellbooks:shield.name: Shield
irons_spellbooks:shield.desc: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.

irons_spellbooks:shockwave.name: Shockwave
irons_spellbooks:shockwave.desc: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.

irons_spellbooks:slow.name: Slow
irons_spellbooks:slow.desc: Apply the Slowed effect to a targeted creature, decreasing its movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:snowball.name: Snowball
irons_spellbooks:snowball.desc: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

irons_spellbooks:sonic_boom.name: Sonic Boom
irons_spellbooks:sonic_boom.desc: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:spectral_hammer.name: Spectral Hammer
irons_spellbooks:spectral_hammer.desc: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.

irons_spellbooks:spider_aspect.name: Aspect of the Spider
irons_spellbooks:spider_aspect.desc: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned

irons_spellbooks:starfall.name: Starfall
irons_spellbooks:starfall.desc: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell

irons_spellbooks:stomp.name: Stomp
irons_spellbooks:stomp.desc: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:summon_ender_chest.name: Summon Ender Chest
irons_spellbooks:summon_ender_chest.desc: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.

irons_spellbooks:summon_horse.name: Summon Horse
irons_spellbooks:summon_horse.desc: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power.

irons_spellbooks:summon_polar_bear.name: Summon Polar Bear
irons_spellbooks:summon_polar_bear.desc: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.

irons_spellbooks:summon_swords.name: Summon Swords
irons_spellbooks:summon_swords.desc: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.

irons_spellbooks:summon_vex.name: Summon Vex
irons_spellbooks:summon_vex.desc: Cast to conjure vexes that will follow, protect, and fight for you.

irons_spellbooks:sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
irons_spellbooks:sunbeam.desc: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.

irons_spellbooks:telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
irons_spellbooks:telekinesis.desc: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.

irons_spellbooks:teleport.name: Teleport
irons_spellbooks:teleport.desc: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.

irons_spellbooks:throw.name: Throw
irons_spellbooks:throw.desc: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.

irons_spellbooks:thunder_step.name: Thunderstep
irons_spellbooks:thunder_step.desc: Teleport a short distance forward, creating a wake of lightning that damages creatures you teleport through.

irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm.desc: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.

irons_spellbooks:touch_dig.name: Touch Dig
irons_spellbooks:touch_dig.desc: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.

irons_spellbooks:volt_strike.name: Volt Strike
irons_spellbooks:volt_strike.desc: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.

irons_spellbooks:wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire
irons_spellbooks:wall_of_fire.desc: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.

irons_spellbooks:wisp.name: Wisp
irons_spellbooks:wisp.desc: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.

irons_spellbooks:wither_skull.name: Wither Skull
irons_spellbooks:wither_skull.desc: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

iss_csw:arcane_infusion.name: Arcane Infusion
iss_csw:arcane_infusion.desc: Provides the Arcane Potency attribute to the infused equipment

iss_csw:barrage_volley.name: Barrage Volley
iss_csw:barrage_volley.desc: After a brief charge, continuously and rapidly fires a barrage of magic arrows forward

iss_csw:blizzard.name: Hail
iss_csw:blizzard.desc: Target a single area summon a blizzard from above for the duration of the spell

iss_csw:charge_ray_of_frost.name: Frost Blast
iss_csw:charge_ray_of_frost.desc: fire a ray of frost at the target. The impacted area explodes, dealing secondary damage.

iss_csw:conjure_refreshment.name: Conjure Refreshment
iss_csw:conjure_refreshment.desc: Creates a magical cookie whose nutritional value scales with your Spell Power!

iss_csw:crimson_laceration.name: Crimson Laceration
iss_csw:crimson_laceration.desc: Unleashes a crimson slash that flies forward, widening as it travels and cutting through everything in its path. It can be attached to your melee attacks by spending an extra cast.

iss_csw:firefly_seeker.name: Firefly Seeker
iss_csw:firefly_seeker.desc: Summons a swarm of fireflies that automatically track and attack the targeted enemy, dealing continuous damage.

iss_csw:frostwhirl_slash.name: Frostwhirl Slash
iss_csw:frostwhirl_slash.desc: Spin unleash a frost-imbued sweeping melee attack. Damage scales with your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments

iss_csw:gust_pro.name: Gust·Pro
iss_csw:gust_pro.desc: Summons a powerful gust of wind that knocks back and damages entities in front of you. Entities that collide with blocks take additional damage.

iss_csw:hemovaporize.name: Hemovaporize
iss_csw:hemovaporize.desc: Curses the target, causing their blood to magically vaporize, inflicting continuous life loss.

iss_csw:ice_plate.name: Ice Plate
iss_csw:ice_plate.desc: Increases Armor Modifier, but some is lost when attacked.

iss_csw:life_tap.name: Lift Tap
iss_csw:life_tap.desc: Continuously drains health, but greatly reduces the cooldown of all spells and Continuously regen mana.

iss_csw:lob_creeper_chain.name: Lob Chain Creeper
iss_csw:lob_creeper_chain.desc: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact and will conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

iss_csw:mana_empowerment.name: Mana Empowerment
iss_csw:mana_empowerment.desc: Improves the defense of the infused equipment

iss_csw:marked_shot.name: Marked Shot
iss_csw:marked_shot.desc: First cast locks onto an enemy. During the duration, firing arrows will launch additional homing magic arrows at the target.

iss_csw:pinning_stake.name: Rooting Stake
iss_csw:pinning_stake.desc: Hurl a stake that ensnares the target with magical roots, preventing all non-magical movement. Damage is doubled against targets that cannot be entangled.

iss_csw:pure_arcane_missile.name: Pure Arcane Missile
iss_csw:pure_arcane_missile.desc: Fires an Arcane Missile that is affected by your spell cloak and special staff

iss_csw:rime_veil.name: Rime Veil
iss_csw:rime_veil.desc: Conjure a dense mist that grants true invisibility. Your first melee attack after breaking invisibility is a guaranteed critical hit

iss_csw:sand_maelstrom.name: Sand Maelstrom
iss_csw:sand_maelstrom.desc: Releases a stationary sand vortex. Cast again to enlarge it and move it in the direction you specify

iss_csw:spell_empowerment.name: Spell Empowerment
iss_csw:spell_empowerment.desc: improve you cast next spell's level

iss_csw:spellbreak_burst.name: Spellbreak Burst
iss_csw:spellbreak_burst.desc: After a short charge, release a magical shockwave that dispels nearby spells and deals bonus damage , will deals more damage to undead enemies.

iss_csw:summon_polar_bear.name: summon saddle polar bear
iss_csw:summon_polar_bear.desc: Cast to summon an ride on a faster polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount, even can jump!

iss_csw:summon_spell_clone.name: Illusory Incantation
iss_csw:summon_spell_clone.desc: Marks your current location. Your next other spell is cast by a clone instead. The clone then returns to the marked location.

iss_csw:time_sand.name: Sacred Time Sand
iss_csw:time_sand.desc: First cast starts a timer. Cast again to reduce the cooldown of all your spells by the average of the timed duration

iss_csw:totem_rite.name: Totem Rite
iss_csw:totem_rite.desc: Place a hollow totem at the target location to invoke a ritual circle. Enemies within the area continuously take damage. If it slays a target, an undead totem is successfully created.

iss_elden_ring:adulas_moonblade.name: Adula's Moonblade
iss_elden_ring:adulas_moonblade.desc: Hold to chain slashes with a huge moonlight greatsword that strike all around the caster and freeze enemies, ending in a crescent wave that flies forward.

iss_elden_ring:cannon_of_haima.name: Cannon of Haima
iss_elden_ring:cannon_of_haima.desc: Lobs a heavy glintstone cannonball in an arc that explodes on impact, damaging everything in the blast.

iss_elden_ring:carian_greatsword.name: Carian Greatsword
iss_elden_ring:carian_greatsword.desc: Hold to chain wide slashes with a huge glintstone greatsword that strike all around the caster.

iss_elden_ring:carian_phalanx.name: Carian Phalanx
iss_elden_ring:carian_phalanx.desc: Summons nine glintblades in a semicircle above the caster's head. They wait for an enemy to come in range, then launch at it and track it.

iss_elden_ring:carian_slicer.name: Carian Slicer
iss_elden_ring:carian_slicer.desc: Hold to chain quick, close-range slashes with a glintstone blade.

iss_elden_ring:collapsing_stars.name: Collapsing Stars
iss_elden_ring:collapsing_stars.desc: Fires a scattered volley of eight gravity stars that pull the enemies they hit inwards.

iss_elden_ring:comet.name: Comet
iss_elden_ring:comet.desc: Fires a glintstone comet straight ahead that explodes on impact.

iss_elden_ring:comet_azur.name: Comet Azur
iss_elden_ring:comet_azur.desc: Hold to fire a huge, sustained beam of glintstone energy straight ahead. Cannot be cast while airborne unless flying.

iss_elden_ring:crystal_barrage.name: Crystal Barrage
iss_elden_ring:crystal_barrage.desc: Hold to keep firing a spread of glintstone crystal shards. The caster must stand still on the ground.

iss_elden_ring:crystal_burst.name: Crystal Burst
iss_elden_ring:crystal_burst.desc: Fires a spread of ten homing crystal shards at once. Can be cast while moving.

iss_elden_ring:founding_rain_of_stars.name: Founding Rain of Stars
iss_elden_ring:founding_rain_of_stars.desc: Calls down a rain of glintstone stars around the caster that strikes nearby enemies for several seconds.

iss_elden_ring:gavel_of_haima.name: Gavel of Haima
iss_elden_ring:gavel_of_haima.desc: Swings a giant glintstone hammer down on the ground ahead, hitting what it strikes directly and sending out a damaging shockwave.

iss_elden_ring:glintblade_phalanx.name: Glintblade Phalanx
iss_elden_ring:glintblade_phalanx.desc: Summons five glintblades above the caster's head. They launch at and track enemies that come in range.

iss_elden_ring:glintstone_arc.name: Glintstone Arc
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_arc.desc: Sweeps a wide arc of glintstone energy forward that hits every enemy it passes. Can be cast while moving.

iss_elden_ring:glintstone_comet.name: Glintstone Comet
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_comet.desc: Fires a large glintstone comet that explodes on impact, damaging enemies around where it lands.

iss_elden_ring:glintstone_icecrag.name: Glintstone Icecrag
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_icecrag.desc: Fires a homing shard of ice that bursts on impact, damaging and freezing enemies around it.

iss_elden_ring:glintstone_pebble.name: Glintstone Pebble
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_pebble.desc: Fires a small, fast glintstone projectile.

iss_elden_ring:glintstone_stars.name: Glintstone Stars
iss_elden_ring:glintstone_stars.desc: Fires three glintstone stars that home in on enemies.

iss_elden_ring:gravity_ball.name: Gravity Ball
iss_elden_ring:gravity_ball.desc: Fires a gravity orb that pulls nearby enemies towards where it lands. Deals no damage.

iss_elden_ring:great_glintstone_shard.name: Great Glintstone Shard
iss_elden_ring:great_glintstone_shard.desc: Fires a large glintstone shard that explodes on impact.

iss_elden_ring:greatblade_phalanx.name: Greatblade Phalanx
iss_elden_ring:greatblade_phalanx.desc: Summons three large glintstone greatblades above the caster's head. They launch at and track enemies that come in range.

iss_elden_ring:loretta_greatbow.name: Loretta's Greatbow
iss_elden_ring:loretta_greatbow.desc: Draws a glintstone greatbow and looses a long-range, lightly homing arrow of magic.

iss_elden_ring:magic_glintblade.name: Magic Glintblade
iss_elden_ring:magic_glintblade.desc: Conjures a single glintblade that hovers for a moment, then launches in the direction the caster was looking.

iss_elden_ring:meteorite.name: Meteorite
iss_elden_ring:meteorite.desc: Hold to open a void overhead that rains meteorites onto the area ahead, each exploding where it lands.

iss_elden_ring:meteorite_of_astel.name: Meteorite of Astel
iss_elden_ring:meteorite_of_astel.desc: Hold to open rifts in the sky that drop larger meteorites onto the area ahead, each exploding where it lands.

iss_elden_ring:rock_sling.name: Rock Sling
iss_elden_ring:rock_sling.desc: Pulls three boulders from the ground and hurls them at enemies, homing in on the nearest.

iss_elden_ring:spiral_shard.name: Spiral Shard
iss_elden_ring:spiral_shard.desc: Fires a homing glintstone shard that spirals as it flies.

iss_elden_ring:star_shower.name: Star Shower
iss_elden_ring:star_shower.desc: Fires six glintstone stars that home in on enemies.

iss_elden_ring:starlight.name: Starlight
iss_elden_ring:starlight.desc: Summons a glowing star that lights up the caster's surroundings for two minutes. Casting it again replaces the old one.

iss_elden_ring:stars_of_ruin.name: Stars of Ruin
iss_elden_ring:stars_of_ruin.desc: Fires a volley of twelve stars of ruin that home in on enemies.

iss_elden_ring:swift_glintstone_shard.name: Swift Glintstone Shard
iss_elden_ring:swift_glintstone_shard.desc: Fires a quick, lightly homing glintstone shard.

iss_elden_ring:terra_magica.name: Terra Magica
iss_elden_ring:terra_magica.desc: Inscribes a glintstone sigil on the ground that raises the caster's spell power by 30% while they stand in it. Casting it again replaces the old one.

iss_magicfromtheeast:anchoring_kunai.name: Anchoring Kunai
iss_magicfromtheeast:anchoring_kunai.desc: Give the caster 3 anchoring kunai, dealing damage and apply Anchored Soul effect on hit

iss_magicfromtheeast:ashigaru_squad.name: Ashigaru Squad
iss_magicfromtheeast:ashigaru_squad.desc: Calling upon a squad of Spirit Ashigaru to aid in your battle

iss_magicfromtheeast:bagua_array_circle.name: Bagua Array Circle
iss_magicfromtheeast:bagua_array_circle.desc: Summon a Bagua Circle at designated area, damaging undead mob inside and give its owner Reversal Healing effect

iss_magicfromtheeast:bone_hands.name: Bone Hands
iss_magicfromtheeast:bone_hands.desc: Summon Spirit Bone Hands from the ground, the hands will slam your targets if they are in range

iss_magicfromtheeast:calamity_cut.name: Devastating Cut
iss_magicfromtheeast:calamity_cut.desc: Swing your weapon and strike down a deadly cut, the stronger your weapon, the more powerful the cut is

iss_magicfromtheeast:cloud_ride.name: Magic Cloud
iss_magicfromtheeast:cloud_ride.desc: Summon a Magical Cloud that can be ridden on for a moment

iss_magicfromtheeast:dragon_glide.name: Dragon Glide
iss_magicfromtheeast:dragon_glide.desc: Cast a unstoppable force dragon ahead the caster, deal damage to anything on its path, can break magic shield with a chance

iss_magicfromtheeast:drapes_of_reflectio.name: Drapes Of Reflection
iss_magicfromtheeast:drapes_of_reflectio.desc: Create a magical Jade Drape, deflect any projectile hit it

iss_magicfromtheeast:jade_bullet.name: Jade Bullet
iss_magicfromtheeast:jade_bullet.desc: Throw a jade bullet that deal damage and create a small shockwave on impact

iss_magicfromtheeast:jade_judgement.name: Jade Judgement
iss_magicfromtheeast:jade_judgement.desc: Calling down an giant Jade Dao, deal a massive area of damage on impact

iss_magicfromtheeast:jiangshi_invoke.name: Jiangshi Invoke
iss_magicfromtheeast:jiangshi_invoke.desc: Summon 3 fast and furious Jiangshi to aid in your battle

iss_magicfromtheeast:kitsune_pack.name: Kitsune Pack
iss_magicfromtheeast:kitsune_pack.desc: Summon a pack of Kitsune that will fight for you, inflict soulburn effect on their bite

iss_magicfromtheeast:nephrite_slash.name: Nephrite Slash
iss_magicfromtheeast:nephrite_slash.desc: Striking ahead with a magical jade slash that make nephrite crystals emerging from the ground, spiking mobs above them

iss_magicfromtheeast:phantom_charge.name: Phantom Charge
iss_magicfromtheeast:phantom_charge.desc: Summon a group of samurai horseman that will charge directly into your enemy formation

iss_magicfromtheeast:punishing_heaven.name: Punishing Heaven
iss_magicfromtheeast:punishing_heaven.desc: Summon a Jade Executioner, a great warrior that will behead anything that's against you or the Celestial Court

iss_magicfromtheeast:revenant_of_honor.name: Revenant of Honor
iss_magicfromtheeast:revenant_of_honor.desc: Summon a loyal Spirit Samurai to protect you from threats

iss_magicfromtheeast:soul_burst.name: Soul Burst
iss_magicfromtheeast:soul_burst.desc: Release a soul fire explosion at the caster position, damaging and burning souls of targets caught inside

iss_magicfromtheeast:soul_catalyst.name: Soul Catalyst
iss_magicfromtheeast:soul_catalyst.desc: After done casting, release a barrage of soul skulls, apply soulburn effect on hit

iss_magicfromtheeast:spirit_challenging.name: Spirit Challenging
iss_magicfromtheeast:spirit_challenging.desc: Extracting a part of target soul and then start the challenging. The soul can be attacked and an amount of the damage it took will be transferred to its owner. If the soul get destroyed or the owner try to run out of the challenging zone, they will get a debuff for a moment

iss_magicfromtheeast:splitting_shuriken.name: Splitting Shuriken
iss_magicfromtheeast:splitting_shuriken.desc: Throw a spirit shuriken at the target. Upon hit, split into smaller shurikens that deal half of the original damage.

iss_magicfromtheeast:sword_dance.name: Sword Dance
iss_magicfromtheeast:sword_dance.desc: Summoning magical swords around the caster. After a short delay, the swords will fly toward the last hurt target and stab them

iss_magicfromtheeast:underworld_aid.name: Impermanence's Verdict
iss_magicfromtheeast:underworld_aid.desc: Calling upon 4 Impermanence to verdict targets in a circle, apply slowness, blindness, darkness effect and damage them for 4 second. The damage will scale based on the lost health of the target, up to target's 40% max health

somakespells:abyssal_burn.name: Abyssal Burn
somakespells:abyssal_burn.desc: Conjures magic circles on the ground, expelling abyssal flames into the air.

somakespells:abyssal_orbs.name: Abyssal Orbs
somakespells:abyssal_orbs.desc: Summons several abyssal orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies with direct impact.

somakespells:apocalyptic_burst.name: Apocalyptic Burst
somakespells:apocalyptic_burst.desc: Charges and releases a devastating explosion with high area damage.

somakespells:axe_cleave.name: Axe Cleave
somakespells:axe_cleave.desc: Summons spectral axe cleaves to cut targets in front.

somakespells:blessed_connection.name: Blessed Connection
somakespells:blessed_connection.desc: Links two targets with a blessed bond that shares a portion of healing between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.

somakespells:blessing.name: Blessing
somakespells:blessing.desc: Applies Blessing to yourself, granting Holy Spell Power and healing received bonus.

somakespells:blood_cut.name: Blood Cut
somakespells:blood_cut.desc: Applies Blood Cut to yourself so your attacks deal increased blood cut damage.

somakespells:blood_rush.name: Blood Rush
somakespells:blood_rush.desc: Applies Blood Dash to yourself, granting Blood Spell Power bonus and life steal on damage dealt.

somakespells:bloodbound_blade.name: Bloodbound Blade
somakespells:bloodbound_blade.desc: Hurls the sword in your casting hand. A successful hit crystallizes the victim's blood, rooting them in place.

somakespells:bloodmark.name: Bloodmark
somakespells:bloodmark.desc: Four casts mark points, then the next cast links them into a blood zone that persists and damages targets inside.

somakespells:bloody_legacy.name: Bloody Legacy
somakespells:bloody_legacy.desc: Delivers a blow that strikes the ground, dealing damage to all enemies in a straight line.

somakespells:ceraunus_dash.name: Ceraunus Dash
somakespells:ceraunus_dash.desc: Throws a summoned Ceraunus anchor that launches you toward the enemy.

somakespells:ceraunus_grasp.name: Ceraunus Grasp
somakespells:ceraunus_grasp.desc: Throws a Ceraunus anchor that drags the enemy toward you.

somakespells:chain_connection.name: Chain Connection
somakespells:chain_connection.desc: Binds two targets with an arcane chain, preventing them from moving too far away from each other.

somakespells:combustion.name: Combustion
somakespells:combustion.desc: Applies Combustion to yourself, granting Fire Spell Power and Fire damage bonus for a certain period of time.

somakespells:comforting_lullaby.name: Comforting Lullaby
somakespells:comforting_lullaby.desc: Channels a melody that heals nearby injured players in pulses, including the caster, but also makes each healed player Sleepy.

somakespells:crimson_reflection.name: Crimson Reflection
somakespells:crimson_reflection.desc: Consumes three Spirit spells stored in a Red Soul Lantern to manifest the Red Echo. Defeat the reflection to awaken Red Soul.

somakespells:cursed_connection.name: Cursed Connection
somakespells:cursed_connection.desc: Links two targets with a cursed bond that shares a portion of damage between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.

somakespells:custodia_caeli.name: Custodia Caeli
somakespells:custodia_caeli.desc: Marks the ground you are aiming at with a sacred preparation circle, then calls down Custodia Caeli, a rotating sigil that blesses every player inside with a long-lasting defensive buff.

somakespells:damned_demomans.name: Damned Demoman's
somakespells:damned_demomans.desc: Applies the Demned Demomans effect to yourself, arming an effect that makes you explode in flames.

somakespells:desert_wrath.name: Desert Wrath
somakespells:desert_wrath.desc: Summons tornadoes around you that deal damage on impact.

somakespells:earthbound.name: Earthbound
somakespells:earthbound.desc: Applies Earthbound to yourself, granting Geo and Armor bonus for a certain period of time.

somakespells:eldritch_gambit.name: Eldritch Gambit
somakespells:eldritch_gambit.desc: Applies Eldritch Gambit to yourself as a temporary eldritch buff.

somakespells:ender_corruption.name: Ender Corruption
somakespells:ender_corruption.desc: Inflicts Ender Corruption on yourself, granting Ender Spell Power bonus for a long period of time.

somakespells:eruption.name: Eruption
somakespells:eruption.desc: Aim at the ground to summon an eruption that deals area damage.

somakespells:evocation_fortitude.name: Evocation Fortitude
somakespells:evocation_fortitude.desc: Applies Evocation Fortitude, granting Evocation Spell Power bonus.

somakespells:fire_blast.name: Fire Blast
somakespells:fire_blast.desc: Fire long-range compressed fire beams that can hit targets in front of you.

somakespells:fire_orbs.name: Fire Orbs
somakespells:fire_orbs.desc: Summons several flame orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies.

somakespells:firestorm_vortex.name: Firestorm Vortex
somakespells:firestorm_vortex.desc: Summons a fiery vortex at the target point that pulls nearby enemies inward and scorches them over time.

somakespells:fragmented_requiem.name: Fragmented Requiem
somakespells:fragmented_requiem.desc: Summons a perfect ring of fragmented swords from the earth. They cut once on the rise, hover briefly, then plunge back down for a second blood-soaked strike.

somakespells:funeral_bloom.name: Funeral Bloom
somakespells:funeral_bloom.desc: Conjures a vast withered rose above the target area. In repeated waves, closed rose buds fall toward enemies, telegraph their impact, and bloom violently on the ground, dealing Blood damage and applying Wither. Striking already-withered enemies restores health to the caster.

somakespells:grave_sigil.name: Grave Sigil
somakespells:grave_sigil.desc: Marks a grave sigil on the ground, then detonates it in two soul-charged waves: first a cross, then an X of spectral eruptions.

somakespells:guardian_connection.name: Guardian Connection
somakespells:guardian_connection.desc: Links you to a target with a holy bond. While the bond lasts and you remain alive, the target becomes immune to damage and every prevented hit is redirected to you.

somakespells:halberd_strike.name: Halberd Strike
somakespells:halberd_strike.desc: Summons 3 frontal columns of phantom halberds to strike distant enemies.

somakespells:hydro_slash.name: Hydro Slash
somakespells:hydro_slash.desc: Conjures a water slash that deals damage to enemies in front. Damage gains bonus based on the sword in hand.

somakespells:ignis_shield.name: Ignis Shield
somakespells:ignis_shield.desc: Summons an Ignis Shield with limited health to protect you from frontal impacts.

somakespells:incinerator_slash.name: Incinerator Slash
somakespells:incinerator_slash.desc: Launches a devastating incinerating slash that deals direct fire damage.

somakespells:jingle_bell.name: Jingle Bell
somakespells:jingle_bell.desc: Summons a bell that chimes, dealing area damage with each chime.

somakespells:lightning_ball.name: Lightning Ball
somakespells:lightning_ball.desc: Throws a lightning ball that deals area damage.

somakespells:lightning_cut.name: Lightning Cut
somakespells:lightning_cut.desc: Performs a lightning cut that deals damage and electrocutes the target.

somakespells:lightning_dance.name: Lightning Dance
somakespells:lightning_dance.desc: Launches multiple lightning spears at nearby targets.

somakespells:lightning_field.name: Lightning Field
somakespells:lightning_field.desc: Creates an electricity field that electrocutes the ground and deals continuous damage to enemies.

somakespells:lightning_lash.name: Lightning Lash
somakespells:lightning_lash.desc: Cracks a lightning whip in front to deal direct damage and quickly pull the enemy toward you.

somakespells:lightning_spear.name: Lightning Spear
somakespells:lightning_spear.desc: Throws a summoned lightning spear projectile that deals damage.

somakespells:lightning_strike.name: Lightning Strike
somakespells:lightning_strike.desc: Summons a lightning strike and electrocutes the target.

somakespells:lightning_swarm.name: Lightning Swarm
somakespells:lightning_swarm.desc: Releases a swarm of electric sparks against multiple targets.

somakespells:mirror_strike.name: Mirror Strike
somakespells:mirror_strike.desc: Creates mirrored circles around you to deal area damage.

somakespells:overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
somakespells:overgrowth.desc: Applies Overgrowth to yourself, granting Nature Spell Power bonus and increased bow damage.

somakespells:permafrost.name: Permafrost
somakespells:permafrost.desc: Applies Permafrost to yourself, granting Ice Spell Power and cold damage bonus.

somakespells:phantom_barrage.name: Phantom Barrage
somakespells:phantom_barrage.desc: Summons several cursed arrows that fly toward the target.

somakespells:procession_of_souls.name: Procession of Souls
somakespells:procession_of_souls.desc: Summons a procession of spiritual eruptions in a straight line in front of you.

somakespells:pumpkin_bomb.name: Pumpkin Bomb
somakespells:pumpkin_bomb.desc: Throw an explosive pumpkin that deals impact and area damage.

somakespells:ram_tchum.name: Ram Tchum
somakespells:ram_tchum.desc: Conjures a heavy sonic explosion that deals area damage.

somakespells:render_rush.name: Render Rush
somakespells:render_rush.desc: Performs a frontal dash, dealing damage to anyone in the path.

somakespells:resonant_pulse.name: Resonant Pulse
somakespells:resonant_pulse.desc: Releases a resonant pulse projectile that deals sonic damage.

somakespells:reverberation.name: Reverberation
somakespells:reverberation.desc: Applies Reverberation, granting Sound Spell Power bonus for a certain period of time.

somakespells:ritual_flame.name: Ritual Flame
somakespells:ritual_flame.desc: Launches a ritual flame at the Altar of Fire you are aiming at. If the setup is correct, the pedestal ritual begins.

somakespells:rose_secret.name: The Rose's Secret
somakespells:rose_secret.desc: Wrap yourself in the Rose's Secret, becoming briefly untouchable while withered petals fall around you.

somakespells:sea_serpent.name: Sea Serpent
somakespells:sea_serpent.desc: Summons the Scylla serpent, dealing damage to targets in front of you.

somakespells:sea_serpent_jet.name: Sea Serpent Jet
somakespells:sea_serpent_jet.desc: Fires a Scylla serpent jet from the ground, dealing damage.

somakespells:slumber_melody.name: Slumber Melody
somakespells:slumber_melody.desc: Plays a melody that puts nearby enemies to sleep.

somakespells:soul_bastion.name: Soul Bastion
somakespells:soul_bastion.desc: Replicates the Possessed Paladin's soul shield assault, calling one outer ring of shields inward and a second inner ring outward.

somakespells:soul_grab.name: Soul Grab
somakespells:soul_grab.desc: Maledictus Charge: upon selecting a target, you grab the enemy, launch yourself upward, and slam down with full force, dealing impact damage.

somakespells:soul_latch.name: Soul Latch
somakespells:soul_latch.desc: Latches onto a target with a spectral stab, binding and pulling it toward you before dealing damage in a final releasing burst.

somakespells:soul_reprisal.name: Phantom Daggers
somakespells:soul_reprisal.desc: Launches six cyan spectral daggers in a forward fan. The daggers reverse course after a short distance and can strike enemies again along their return path.

somakespells:soulfall_judgment.name: Soulfall Judgment
somakespells:soulfall_judgment.desc: Unleashes a soul-charged impact around the caster and calls down a cyan-green formation of spectral blades.

somakespells:sovereign_armory.name: Sovereign Armory
somakespells:sovereign_armory.desc: Opens a golden armory of portals behind the caster, then fires its conjured weapons in sequence at the aimed target.

somakespells:spectral_rondo.name: Spectral Rondo
somakespells:spectral_rondo.desc: Charges forward in a spectral spin, striking twice in 360 degrees while three parallel trails of cyan Soul Pillars erupt along the path.

somakespells:spiral_of_ruin.name: Spiral of Ruin
somakespells:spiral_of_ruin.desc: Hurls a spectral trident that unfurls a telegraphed spiral of soul eruptions from its point of impact.

somakespells:spirit_empowerment.name: Spirit Empowerment
somakespells:spirit_empowerment.desc: Applies Spirit Empowerment to yourself, granting Spirit Spell Power bonus.

somakespells:storm_aura.name: Storm Aura
