somakespells:storm_aura.desc: Creates a storm aura around you that pulls in enemies and explodes at the end, knocking everyone away.

somakespells:submerge.name: Submerge
somakespells:submerge.desc: Applies Submerged to yourself, increasing Aqua Spell Power and Aquatic Mobility for a period of time.

somakespells:summon_drowned.name: Summon Drowned
somakespells:summon_drowned.desc: Summons an allied Drowned whose health and damage scale with Aqua power.

somakespells:symmetry_empowerment.name: Symmetry Empowerment
somakespells:symmetry_empowerment.desc: Applies Symmetry Empowerment to yourself, granting Symmetry Spell Power bonus.

somakespells:thunder_cloud.name: Thunder Cloud
somakespells:thunder_cloud.desc: Conjures a Thunder Cloud that repeatedly strikes with Rain and Lightning.

somakespells:water_ball.name: Water Ball
somakespells:water_ball.desc: Throws a water ball projectile that deals damage on impact.

somakespells:water_control.name: Water Control
somakespells:water_control.desc: Keeps a suspended mass of water in front of you, following your aim while you channel it.

somakespells:water_spear.name: Water Spear
somakespells:water_spear.desc: Launches a summoned water spear projectile at the target.

somakespells:winged_ruin.name: Winged Ruin
somakespells:winged_ruin.desc: Unfurls the Possessed Paladin's original crimson wings, rises amid converging souls and dives into a selected point, unleashing the Finisher's four cardinal formations of Soul Pillar Explosions.

somakespells:withered_rose_vortex.name: Withered Rose Vortex
somakespells:withered_rose_vortex.desc: Summons a tornado of withered rose petals at the target point. The vortex drags enemies inward, lifts them, deals Blood damage in pulses, and afflicts them with Wither.

traveloptics:abyssal_blast.name: Abyssal Blast
traveloptics:abyssal_blast.desc: Cast to fire a devastating beam of abyssal energy in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around. Can only be found by defeating The Leviathan.

traveloptics:aerial_collapse.name: Aerial Collapse
traveloptics:aerial_collapse.desc: Inflict an effect that lifts enemies into the air for 2.5 seconds before crushing them down to the floor, dealing percentage-based damage to their health. The damage dealt ignores any kind of damage cap.

traveloptics:annihilation.name: Annihilation
traveloptics:annihilation.desc: Targets enemies and nukes them with a devastating spell that deals massive damage. Survivors are inflicted with a radiation effect, preventing incoming healing. Can only be found from Toxic Caves ruins and by slaying Nucleepers.

traveloptics:aqua_missiles.name: Aqua Missiles
traveloptics:aqua_missiles.desc: Fires a rapid succession of water bolts that deal damage and home in on nearby entities.

traveloptics:ashen_breath.name: Ashen Breath
traveloptics:ashen_breath.desc: Exhale a cloud of darkening ash, damaging and blinding creatures in its reach.

traveloptics:astral_sense.name: Astral Sense
traveloptics:astral_sense.desc: Reveals the pathfinder of nearby entities in a radius. Normal casting alerts the caster about nearby threats, while crouch casting helps sense loot, traps, and valuables like Arcane Debris.

traveloptics:axe_of_the_doomed.name: Axe Of The Doomed
traveloptics:axe_of_the_doomed.desc: Summon a Aptrgangr to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Aptrgangr.

traveloptics:blackout.name: Blackout
traveloptics:blackout.desc: Creates a lingering anti-magic field that suppresses abilities within its radius. Players caught in the zone are unable to cast spells and use items. Moving within the field inflicts small damage. Can only be obtained by defeating the Enraged Dead King.

traveloptics:blink.name: Blink
traveloptics:blink.desc: Low-cost, short-ranged teleport in the direction you're moving. Works omni-directionally.

traveloptics:blood_howl.name: Blood Howl
traveloptics:blood_howl.desc: Cast to shoot wither howitzer projectiles at your target. This spell has recasts.

traveloptics:bubble_spray.name: Bubble Spray
traveloptics:bubble_spray.desc: Sprays a stream of bubbles that deals damage, slows affected entities, and applies the Wet effect.

traveloptics:burning_judgment.name: Burning Judgment
traveloptics:burning_judgment.desc: Creates Ignis flame strikes on the ground in a straight line for a duration. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the strikes transform into soul-fired flame strikes. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignis.

traveloptics:call_forth_the_dead_king.name: Call Forth The Dead King
traveloptics:call_forth_the_dead_king.desc: Summons an Enraged Dead King boss to challenge you. Defeating it grants a higher chance of obtaining high-quality loot, including the exclusive spell Blackout. The Enraged Dead King can cast additional powerful spells. The high mana cost is intentional to make it only cast-able from scrolls. Can only be found in Catacombs Chests.

traveloptics:conjure_void_tomes.name: Conjure Void Tomes
traveloptics:conjure_void_tomes.desc: Summon magical Void Tomes to fight by your side and unleash spell attacks upon your enemies. Can be found in Void Cathedral.

traveloptics:coral_barrage.name: Coral Barrage
traveloptics:coral_barrage.desc: Cast to mark targets, unleashing a barrage of coral bolts at the end of recasting. Bolts damage, pierce, and shatter into shrapnel, dealing AoE damage within a 2-block radius.

traveloptics:cursed_blast.name: Cursed Blast
traveloptics:cursed_blast.desc: Channel the essence of darkness, unleashing a cryogenic blast that shatters the resolve of those caught within. Amplified by absorbed soul fragments. Only cast-able from Cursed Wraithblade.

traveloptics:cursed_minefield.name: Cursed Minefield
traveloptics:cursed_minefield.desc: On cast, summons Leviathan’s abyssal mines in a radius around the player. The mine placement is random, but they cannot go below the caster’s Y level.

traveloptics:cursed_revenants.name: Cursed Revenants
traveloptics:cursed_revenants.desc: Cast to summon random Draugr variants that'll protect you and fight for you.

traveloptics:death_laser.name: Death Laser
traveloptics:death_laser.desc: Cast to shoot The Harbinger Laser beam in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around.

traveloptics:despair.name: Despair
traveloptics:despair.desc: Launches a magical Axe Blade forward on the look direction piercing through entities in its path. Deals damage to all caught in its trajectory.

traveloptics:echo_of_the_abyss.name: Echo Of The Abyss
traveloptics:echo_of_the_abyss.desc: Summons a Hullbreaker to fight and protect the caster. Can be used as an underwater mount, granting water breathing while ridden. Can only be obtained from defeating Hullbreaker.

traveloptics:eek.name: Eek
traveloptics:eek.desc: Eek yourself and eek targeted entity.

traveloptics:em_pulse.name: EM-Pulse
traveloptics:em_pulse.desc: Cast to stun nearby entities for a short duration. Stunned enemies has a visual indicator.

traveloptics:eternal_sentinel.name: Eternal Sentinel
traveloptics:eternal_sentinel.desc: Conjure a friendly Ender Golem to protect and fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Ender Golem.

traveloptics:extinction.name: Extinction
traveloptics:extinction.desc: Calls down a massive asteroid, smashing into the ground with incredible force. The impact devastates a large area, leaving a crater that erupts with searing heat, turning all within to ash. Only cast-able from Gauntlet Of Extinction.

traveloptics:flood_slash.name: Flood Slash
traveloptics:flood_slash.desc: Unleashes a aqua-infused slash projectile that deals damage and converts damage dealt into Mana for the caster. Hitting multiple entities increases the caster's Mana regeneration temporarily.

traveloptics:floodgate.name: Floodgate
traveloptics:floodgate.desc: Imposes a damage cap on the caster, ensuring that any incoming damage exceeding the threshold is reduced to the cap. When damage surpasses the threshold, waves surge outward in all directions, dealing damage.

traveloptics:gyro_slash.name: Gyro Slash
traveloptics:gyro_slash.desc: Transform the Infernal Devastator into Blade Mode, slashing entities in front of you. Using an Infernal Devastator Evo 2 or higher creates a slash projectile that pulls in nearby entities with a fiery vacuum effect before bursting into flame jets. Only cast-able from Infernal Devastator.

traveloptics:halberd_horizon.name: Halberd Horizon
traveloptics:halberd_horizon.desc: Summons Phantom Halberds in the battlefield around the caster, damaging entities caught in it. Can only be obtained by defeating Maledictus.

traveloptics:hydroshot.name: Hydroshot
traveloptics:hydroshot.desc: Fires a small water bolt that deals damage, slows enemies, and applies the wet effect.

traveloptics:ignited_onslaught.name: Ignited Onslaught
traveloptics:ignited_onslaught.desc: Cast to summon a Ignited Revenant & Berserker to protect you and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignited Revenant and Ignited Berserker.

traveloptics:jet_steam.name: Jet Steam
traveloptics:jet_steam.desc: Generates a powerful surge that propels the caster at high speed while using elytra or swimming underwater, granting temporary water breathing.

traveloptics:lava_bomb.name: Lava Bomb
traveloptics:lava_bomb.desc: Launches projectiles at a 45° angle in front of the caster, that explodes upon impact, creating lava pools. When cast, the spell absorbs nearby lava.

traveloptics:lingering_strain.name: Lingering Strain
traveloptics:lingering_strain.desc: Grants a effect; During that any burst damage you get will be split into 4 different smaller damage and will be dealt over time giving the caster time to recover.

traveloptics:magnetron_deployment.name: Magnetron Deployment
traveloptics:magnetron_deployment.desc: Cast to deploy a Magnetron that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Magnetron.

traveloptics:mechanized_predator.name: Mechanized Predators
traveloptics:mechanized_predator.desc: Cast to deploy Watchers and The Prowler that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating The Watcher and The Prowler.

traveloptics:meteor_storm.name: Meteor Storm
traveloptics:meteor_storm.desc: Summons Ignis fireballs to rain down from the sky. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the fireballs transform into soul-fired projectiles.

traveloptics:nocturnal_swarm.name: Nocturnal Swarm
traveloptics:nocturnal_swarm.desc: Cast to summon deadly swarm of Vesper.

traveloptics:nullflare.name: Nullflare
traveloptics:nullflare.desc: Cast to inflict Nullflare Ice on enemies, or Crouch Cast to inflict Nullflare Fire; when Ice meets Fire, or vice versa, it triggers a Nullflare Blast, dealing damage. Additional effect stacks increase the Blast damage.

traveloptics:orbital_void.name: Orbital Void
traveloptics:orbital_void.desc: Shoots Abyssal Orb projectiles in a circular pattern around the player, damaging entities. On the initial cast, Abyssal Orbs home in on nearby entities.

traveloptics:primal_pack.name: Primal Pack
traveloptics:primal_pack.desc: Summon Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus.

traveloptics:primordial_steed.name: Primordial Steed
traveloptics:primordial_steed.desc: Summon a Atlatitan that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Luxtructosaurus.

traveloptics:psychic_bolt.name: Psychic Bolt
traveloptics:psychic_bolt.desc: Select multiple targets on cast. On recast end, fires small projectiles that confuse targets on hit, making them prioritize attacking nearby non-player entities.

traveloptics:rainfall.name: Rainfall
traveloptics:rainfall.desc: Calls down a rainstorm that grants immunity to negative effects for the caster and applies the Wet effect to everyone within.

traveloptics:rapid_laser.name: Rapid Laser
traveloptics:rapid_laser.desc: Continuously shoots Harbinger's pew-pew laser to targeted entities.

traveloptics:reversal.name: Reversal
traveloptics:reversal.desc: Reverses any incoming damage with increased power. Additionally, it can copy incoming projectiles.

traveloptics:serpentide.name: Serpentide
traveloptics:serpentide.desc: Summons a cascade of Storm Serpents that strike down in a straight line one after another, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Damage ignores i-frames. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.

traveloptics:shadowed_miasma.name: Shadowed Miasma
traveloptics:shadowed_miasma.desc: Inflicts nearby enemies with the abyssal curse effect and infuses your weapon with the same curse. Dealing damage to an enemy during the effect has a chance to spread the effect to nearby enemies.

traveloptics:shear_of_the_stars.name: Shear Of The Stars
traveloptics:shear_of_the_stars.desc: Summons a Dragon Spirit that flies forward, passing through blocks and damaging enemies it hits. It leaves behind a Stellar Trail that deals damage over time to nearby enemies. Dragon damage ignores I-Frames. Requires Stellothorn to cast this spell.

traveloptics:skypiercer.name: Skypiercer
traveloptics:skypiercer.desc: Calls down a phantom Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom from the sky, dealing impact damage in an area. The trident remains, pulsing for 50% of the impact damage at intervals and inflicting Tidal Torment, causing thrown Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom to explode in an area and slowing affected enemies. Requires Trident Of The Eternal Maelstrom to cast this spell.

traveloptics:spectral_blink.name: Spectral Blink
traveloptics:spectral_blink.desc: After activation, the caster has 3 seconds. During this time, they can teleport to any entity they are looking at, even through walls. Any entities within the teleportation range will be revealed to the caster.

traveloptics:stele_cascade.name: Stele Cascade
traveloptics:stele_cascade.desc: Summons Ancient Desert Stele in a radius, crashing down and dealing damage.

traveloptics:sticky_steed_summon.name: Sticky Steed Summon
traveloptics:sticky_steed_summon.desc: Conjure a Gum Worm that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Gum Worm.

traveloptics:summon_desert_dwellers.name: Desert Dwellers
traveloptics:summon_desert_dwellers.desc: Summon Koboletons and Wadjet to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Koboletons and Wadjet.

traveloptics:supernova.name: Supernova
traveloptics:supernova.desc: Summon a collapsing star that builds in intensity over time. After a short delay, it erupts in a massive explosion, dealing heavy damage and gives birth to a supermassive black hole. The black hole pulls in nearby entities and continues to deal damage within its radius. Requires Wand of Final Light to cast this spell.

traveloptics:sword_of_the_ancients.name: Sword Of The Ancients'
traveloptics:sword_of_the_ancients.desc: Summon kobolediator to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Kobolediator.

traveloptics:tectonic_rift.name: Tectonic Rift
traveloptics:tectonic_rift.desc: Needs the Gauntlet of Extinction in the main hand. Tears open a ring of erupting magma around the caster that damages enemies standing in it for 10 seconds.

traveloptics:the_forgotten_beast.name: The Forgotten Beast
traveloptics:the_forgotten_beast.desc: Summon Forsaken, a powerful, rideable creature that fight alongside you. However, beware: its will is not fully tameable, and its ferocity may prove unpredictable. Can only be obtained by defeating Forsaken.

traveloptics:the_howling_tempest.name: The Howling Tempest
traveloptics:the_howling_tempest.desc: After a 3s charge, conjures a raging tempest that rains down water spears, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Each hit has a 50% chance to either increase the Wet amplifier (up to 10x) or extend its duration by 2s. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.

traveloptics:tidal_grasp.name: Tidal Grasp
traveloptics:tidal_grasp.desc: Pulls a targeted entity toward the caster, striking them with force to deal damage while applying a Stun and the Wet effect.

traveloptics:tsunami.name: Tsunami
traveloptics:tsunami.desc: Call forth an unstoppable tide that surges forward, slamming into enemies, dealing damage, sweeping them away, and applying wet effect.

traveloptics:vigor_siphon.name: Vigor Siphon
traveloptics:vigor_siphon.desc: Cast to connect with your nearest summon. Damage dealt by the summon heals you, and your damage heals the summon in return. If you die while tethered, the linked summon is sacrificed to restore you with 8hp

traveloptics:violent_skreech.name: Paralyzing Skreech
traveloptics:violent_skreech.desc: Continuously pulsate sound blast to Shred Armor, Damage Nearby enemies and Applying Chilled effect. 2% of damage deal converted into lifesteal.

traveloptics:void_devourer.name: Void Devourer
traveloptics:void_devourer.desc: Creates a Dimensional Rift that pulls everything around it and damages enemies caught in it.

traveloptics:void_eruption.name: Void Eruption
traveloptics:void_eruption.desc: Shoots Void Howitzer Projectiles that explode and summon void runes in a radius. This spell can be recast.

traveloptics:vortex_of_the_deep.name: Vortex Of The Deep
traveloptics:vortex_of_the_deep.desc: Conjures a massive water vortex that pulls entities toward its center, slowing them and applying Wet effect. The vortex periodically discharges Boltstrikes to devastate those within it's radius.

traveloptics:vortex_punch.name: Vortex Uppercut
traveloptics:vortex_punch.desc: Create a Void Vortex, pulling enemies in. Teleport into it and unleash a crushing uppercut, dealing damage and sending foes flying upward.

wind_spellbooks:aeropic.name: Aeropic
wind_spellbooks:aeropic.desc: Leap forward in a spinning, voltaic attack that will damage your first target and launch you into the air. As long as you hit your target, the attack can be repeated.

wind_spellbooks:almighty_push.name: Almighty Push
wind_spellbooks:almighty_push.desc: Create a area of wind around you knocking back creatures in every directions, causing damage if they impact a wall

wind_spellbooks:iron_slash.name: Iron Slash
wind_spellbooks:iron_slash.desc: Focus yourself before doing a big dash that slash your enemies

wind_spellbooks:tailwind.name: Tailwind
wind_spellbooks:tailwind.desc: Imbue yourself with the strength of the wind, increasing your speed and your mobility in the air.

wind_spellbooks:tornado.name: Tornado
wind_spellbooks:tornado.desc: Around a targeted location, create a tornado that will suck in nearby creatures and propulse them in the air

wind_spellbooks:wind_blade.name: Wind Blade
wind_spellbooks:wind_blade.desc: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of wind, slicing through creatures

mdvlcraft:arcane_sustenance.name: Arcane Sustenance
mdvlcraft:arcane_sustenance.desc: Turn mana into food: restores %s hunger shank and %s saturation.

mdvlcraft:barrage.name: Barrage
mdvlcraft:barrage.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: hold to throw a flurry of punches.

mdvlcraft:bird_strike.name: Bird Strike
mdvlcraft:bird_strike.desc: A crow overflowing with energy dives into your target.

mdvlcraft:blind_investment.name: Blind Investment
mdvlcraft:blind_investment.desc: Send a crow that blinds whatever it hits.

mdvlcraft:blitz.name: Blitz
mdvlcraft:blitz.desc: Dash forward at incredible speed and cut down whatever is in the way. No weapon needed.

mdvlcraft:block_clap.name: Block Clap
mdvlcraft:block_clap.desc: Clap to swap places with the block you are looking at.

mdvlcraft:blood_meteorite.name: Blood Meteorite
mdvlcraft:blood_meteorite.desc: Shoot a compressed ball of blood (Cursed Fate Blood Manipulation, paid for with mana).

mdvlcraft:boogie_woogie.name: Boogie Woogie
mdvlcraft:boogie_woogie.desc: Clap to swap places with the creature you are looking at (10 blocks).

mdvlcraft:cleave.name: Cleave
mdvlcraft:cleave.desc: Hold to carve repeatedly at a target in front of you.

mdvlcraft:controlled_collapse.name: Controlled Collapse
mdvlcraft:controlled_collapse.desc: Summon a flock of crows that circles for a few seconds, then dives in a barrage of bird strikes.

mdvlcraft:convergence.name: Convergence
mdvlcraft:convergence.desc: Concentrate your blood, empowering your attacks for a while.

mdvlcraft:crimson_binding.name: Crimson Binding
mdvlcraft:crimson_binding.desc: Bind the creature you are looking at with blood.

mdvlcraft:dismantle.name: Dismantle
mdvlcraft:dismantle.desc: Fire an invisible slash that cuts the first thing it hits.

mdvlcraft:doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
mdvlcraft:doppelganger.desc: Summon a double of yourself that fights at your side and repeats your attacks at half damage. Tap again while looking at an enemy to send the double behind it; hold for 2 seconds to swap places with it; sneak and cast to dismiss it.

mdvlcraft:focus.name: Focus
mdvlcraft:focus.desc: Your next strike within 10 s (a punch, a kick or one of your arts) is a guaranteed Black Flash: 2.5x damage and a short stun.

mdvlcraft:follow_up_kick.name: Follow Up Kick
mdvlcraft:follow_up_kick.desc: Projection sorcery: teleport to your target and kick it away. Sneak and cast to switch between the Normal and Flow forms (Flow freezes the target in a frame and shatters it).

mdvlcraft:follow_up_punch.name: Follow Up Punch
mdvlcraft:follow_up_punch.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: teleport behind the last creature you hit.

mdvlcraft:gravity_stomp.name: Gravity Stomp
mdvlcraft:gravity_stomp.desc: Stomp the ground, hitting everything around you. Also uses stamina and has its own cooldown.

mdvlcraft:heavy_blow.name: Heavy Blow
mdvlcraft:heavy_blow.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: punch very hard. No weapon needed.

mdvlcraft:knockout.name: Knockout
mdvlcraft:knockout.desc: A straight punch at the creature in reach: 1.5x damage, and it blacks out, staggered like a Punishment Kick.

mdvlcraft:leaping_crush.name: Leaping Crush
mdvlcraft:leaping_crush.desc: Cursed Fate's Heavenly Restriction art: leap high and crash down on your foes. No weapon needed.

mdvlcraft:malevolent_shrine.name: Malevolent Shrine
mdvlcraft:malevolent_shrine.desc: Cast to raise your closed domain: a black barrier dome around you. While it stands, hold the cast key on it to cut apart everything inside the dome. It drains 20 mana a second and closes when you run out; sneak and cast to close it sooner. Its 120 s cooldown starts when it closes.

mdvlcraft:myriad_blades.name: Myriad Blades Convergence
mdvlcraft:myriad_blades.desc: Summon a storm of blades from the swords you carry. Cast on the ground with a sword in hand; it has its own cooldown.

mdvlcraft:open_malevolent_shrine.name: Malevolent Shrine: Open
mdvlcraft:open_malevolent_shrine.desc: Cast to raise the shrine without a barrier. While it stands, hold the cast key on it to cut everything around it, out to 20 blocks. It drains 25 mana a second and closes when you run out; sneak and cast to close it sooner.

mdvlcraft:phantom_movement.name: Phantom Movement
mdvlcraft:phantom_movement.desc: Projection sorcery: hold to map a path along the 24 fps rule, then release to dash it at full output, striking what you pass.

mdvlcraft:piercing_blood.name: Piercing Blood
mdvlcraft:piercing_blood.desc: Hold to fire a beam of compressed blood.

mdvlcraft:silent_appraisal.name: Silent Appraisal
mdvlcraft:silent_appraisal.desc: Send out a crow that circles above you. While it lives, creatures around you glow. It drains 3 mana a second while it flies and ends when your mana runs out, the crow flies out of sight, or you sneak.

mdvlcraft:slicing_exorcism.name: Slicing Exorcism
mdvlcraft:slicing_exorcism.desc: Create a living blood worm that sends flying blood at your target.

mdvlcraft:soul_hunt.name: Soul Hunt
mdvlcraft:soul_hunt.desc: Launch an assault forward; kills and hits on guard-broken targets shorten its cooldown (at most 2 resets per cast) and grant buffs. Cast on the ground with a weapon in hand.

mdvlcraft:stance.name: Stance
mdvlcraft:stance.desc: Cast to take up or drop your stance. Sneak and cast to change its element.

mdvlcraft:surprise_attack.name: Surprise Attack
mdvlcraft:surprise_attack.desc: Teleport behind the creature you are looking at and strike. No weapon needed.

mdvlcraft:uppercut.name: Uppercut
mdvlcraft:uppercut.desc: Cursed Fate's melee art: an uppercut that throws targets into the air.

acgbattlescytherevived:execution.name: Execution
acgbattlescytherevived:execution.tip: A technique that sucks the souls of the enemies upon killing them.

cdmoveset:bloodwolf.name: Blood Wolf
cdmoveset:bloodwolf.tip: When the wolf howls, it is time for a counterattack. Gain the protection of the wolf god by dodging and defeating enemies. When the skill level reaches 10, you will gain the protection of the wolf god, enhancing your attacks and having a chance to interrupt enemy attacks.

cdmoveset:cdparryskill.name: New version technical update, this skill is useless
cdmoveset:cdparryskill.tip: Specially made parry, I don't know how to make it, don't ask

cdmoveset:ex_yamato_step.name: Yamato step (cannot be learned)
cdmoveset:ex_yamato_step.tip: Exclusive dodge skill for Yamato (Without Yamato, you cannot use this skill. When holding the Yamato , and dodge is set to Phantom, this skill will activate automatically)

cdmoveset:fatalfalsh.name: Fatal Flash
cdmoveset:fatalfalsh.tip: Lock onto a low-health enemy and perform a kill, which cannot be interrupted during execution (Weapons allowed: uchigatana, katana, tachi, longsword)

cdmoveset:greatsword_dual_skill.name: Earth Splitting Slash
cdmoveset:greatsword_dual_skill.tip: A powerful ground-shaking attack that knocks down all enemies within range

cdmoveset:greeat_tachiskill.name: Blood Blade
cdmoveset:greeat_tachiskill.tip: After a brief charge, stun the enemy, deal a fatal attack, and effectively push back the enemy.

cdmoveset:guardparry.name: Absolute Defense
cdmoveset:guardparry.tip: Allows you to adjust your defensive stance and block all blockable attacks during the skill duration. Each defeated enemy restores one layer of defense points (the base value of defense points is 4, the Sweeping Blade enchantment can increase defense points)

cdmoveset:katanaskill.name: Critical Strike
cdmoveset:katanaskill.tip: A swift thrust that pierces through enemies in its path. In a running state, you can sheathe the sword and deliver a powerful strike.

cdmoveset:katanaspskill.name: Critical Strike
cdmoveset:katanaspskill.tip: Adopt a stance to block the enemy's attack and then execute a killing blow.

cdmoveset:lethalslicing.name: Lethal Slash
cdmoveset:lethalslicing.tip: Stun the enemy and deliver a powerful strike. The number of strikes varies depending on the number of enemies.

cdmoveset:shiled_slahs.name: Shield Bash!!!!
cdmoveset:shiled_slahs.tip: Use the shield to block the enemy's attack and stun the enemy.

cdmoveset:spearslash.name: Spear Dance
cdmoveset:spearslash.tip: Grab surrounding enemies and deliver a powerful knockdown.

cdmoveset:sstep.name: Step (for creatures, bosses, etc.)
cdmoveset:sstep.tip: A meaningless dodge skill book, maybe the author was too lazy to delete it. It doesn't differ much from dodging, except that it reduces stamina consumption by 1. (Stamina: %d)

cdmoveset:sword_slash.name: Enhanced Sweeping Blade
cdmoveset:sword_slash.tip: Spin forward and deliver a powerful strike.

cdmoveset:wind_slash.name: Steel Whirlwind
cdmoveset:wind_slash.tip: Raise your greatsword and slash all surrounding enemies.

cdmoveset:wolf_dodge.name: Wolf God Leap
cdmoveset:wolf_dodge.tip: Allows you to use different actions to dodge. A successful dodge can trigger special effects and restore weapon charge.

cdmoveset:yamato_step.name: Phantom
cdmoveset:yamato_step.tip: Teleport in a specified direction. Dodge all dodgeable attacks. (Stamina: %d)

cdmoveset:yamatoskill.name: During the preparation phase of normal skill usage, being attacked by the enemy can trigger a counterattack. After 1a, 2a, 3a, you can release additional combos, and after a parry, you can release the Illusory Blade Realm for a counterattack.
cdmoveset:yamatoskill.tip: Depending on the attack, the combo delivered is different.

combat_evolution:shield_counter.name: Shield Counter
combat_evolution:shield_counter.tip: When holding a shield in your off-hand Press [Guard + Weapon Innate] consume stamina to swing the shield If you successfully block an attack, you will stun the enemy, restore your stamina, and gain stun immunity, resistance, and strength effect

epicfight:endurance.tip: Grants stun resistance as an amount of stamina consumed for %s seconds if a player is hit while preparing an attack.

epicfight:everlasting_allegiance.name: Everlasting Allegiance
epicfight:everlasting_allegiance.tip: Recall your thrown trident, damaging all enemies in it's path.

epicfight:eviscerate.name: Eviscerate

epicfight:forbidden_strength.name: Forbidden Strength
epicfight:forbidden_strength.tip: Consumes health instead of stamina when it's insufficient.

epicfight:grasping_spire.tip: Stab through your enemy to pull them in. Successfully hitting an enemy will perform a second strike, knocking them back based on how many enemies were hit.

epicfight:guard.name: Guard
epicfight:guard.tip: Right-click to guard against frontal attacks. Continued guarding will consume more stamina.

epicfight:hypervitality.name: Hyper Vitality
epicfight:hypervitality.tip: Uses stamina instead of weapon charge when it's not full.

epicfight:impact_guard.name: Impact Guard

epicfight:katana_skill.name: Stance Flow
epicfight:katana_skill.tip: Attacks build stance stacks. Sweeping Edge increases the cap. Current weapon cap: %s. Idle Cast: Swap between [Unsheathed] and [Sheathed] stances for free. [Sheathed Skill]: Consumes all stacks to unleash (stacks - 1) extra dimensional slashes

epicfight:meteor_slam.name: Meteor Slam

epicfight:parrying.name: Parrying
epicfight:parrying.tip: Allows a player to time guards accordingly to prevent stamina use. Player is able to guard against ranged attacks.

epicfight:roll.name: Roll
epicfight:roll.tip: Roll in the direction a player is moving. Evades all incoming attacks.

epicfight:sharp_stab.name: Sharp Stab

epicfight:stamina_pillager.name: Stamina Pillager

epicfight:sweeping_edge.name: Sweeping Edge

falchionmoveset:falchion_art.tip: Slice enemies in a wide area. There will be three different attacks depending on the direction you type. s_epicfied:mortal_slash.name: Mortal Slash
s_epicfied:mortal_slash.tip: Cut their souls in half and send them to hell! This skill can be stacked up to 7. Hold LMB to release powerful strike(require 3 stacks). Hold RMB+LMB to release another powerful strike(require 4 stacks). Special keys: Sneak+Hold LMB to release a powerful flash(require 6 stacks). Hold LMB while sprinting to release powerful slash forward(require 5 stacks). While having 7 stacks, hold LMB firt and then RMB+LMB to release follow-up powerful strike.

s_epicfied:pierce_rush.name: Piercing Rush
s_epicfied:pierce_rush.tip: Hold LMB to dash toward target and pierce them. Sneak+Hold LMB to slash ground around you and Knock down nearby enemies.

s_epicfied:rocket.name: Geschoss
s_epicfied:rocket.tip: Target locked! Hold LMB to charge up your next attack. Upon release perform flying attack forward.

s_epicfied:rushing_slam.name: Rushing Slam
s_epicfied:rushing_slam.tip: Hold LMB to channel yourself. After 2 seconds release powerful dash with ground slam!

s_epicfied:scythe_slash.name: le Messor
s_epicfied:scythe_slash.tip: It's harvest time! This skill can be stacked up to 3. Just a harvest: Hold LMB. Rushing harvest: Hold LMB while sprinting. Deadly harvest: Hold RMB+LMB(require 2 stacks). Total harvest: Sneak+Hold LMB(require 2 stacks).

s_epicfied:shading_slash.name: Sign from Shadows
s_epicfied:shading_slash.tip: Must've been a blink:D. Hold LMB to cut through light, while having more than 1 stack hold LMB right after first strike to peform second(require additional 2 stacks). Hold LMB while sprinting to do teleportation attack on target(require 2 stacks). Sneak+Hold LMB to do teleportation attack behind target. Hold RMB+LMB for ultimate(require max stacks).

s_epicfied:teleporting_skill.name: Concitus
s_epicfied:teleporting_skill.tip: Gotta go fast! This skill can be stacked up to 5. Hold LMB to perform teleportation combo on selected target(require 2 stacks). Hold RMB+LMB to teleport above target and attack it(require 3 stacks). Sneak+Hold LMB to teleport near target and slash it(require 2 stacks). Hold LMB while sprinting to release aerial slash(effective while target it above or flying near you).

s_epicfied:twinblade_skill.name: Tripudium
s_epicfied:twinblade_skill.tip: You thought there will be something? nah, get out!.. Hold LMB to do flight attack. Jump+Hold LMB to send yourself into air and slam the ground. Hold LMB while sprinting to release spinning attack.

sword_soaring:babylon.name: Babylonian Armory
sword_soaring:babylon.tip: Unleash treasury of blades raining from skies "Hmph. Noble armaments deserve proper use" Cooldown: %.1fs press [%s]

sword_soaring:kill_aura_1.name: Stellar Annihilation: Cataclysm
sword_soaring:kill_aura_1.tip: Celestial stars descend to mortal plane,/Ring's radiance brings purging flame Summons meteor array damaging nearby foes (scales with weapon) Duration: %.1fs Cooldown: %.1fs press [%s]

sword_soaring:kill_aura_2.name: Bloodlotus Incineration
sword_soaring:kill_aura_2.tip: Crimson rings bloom as lotus fire,/Scorching all life, leaving none entire Ignites blazing array (scales with weapon), sets foes aflame Duration: %.1fs Cooldown: %.1fs press [%s]

sword_soaring:rain_sword.name: Celestial Array: Purge
sword_soaring:rain_sword.tip: Big Dipper's might forms sword domain,/Where array reaches - evil's bane Each strike summons %d-%d phantom blades Duration: %.1fs Cooldown: %.1fs press [%s]

sword_soaring:screen_sword.name: Voidblade Domain: Severance
sword_soaring:screen_sword.tip: Sword-qi weaves net sealing realms eight,/Array complete - heaven-earth resonate Summon Voidblade Domain to deflect harm. Nullifies projectiles, counters melee strikes with blade's maximum might Loses 1 sword per %d/6 hits, healing %.1f HP Duration: %.1fs Cooldown: %.1fs press [%s]

sword_soaring:sword_soaring_apprentice.name: Sword Soaring: Lv1
sword_soaring:sword_soaring_apprentice.tip: Apprentice Double click [%s] to take off. Holding [%s] to speed up.

sword_soaring:sword_soaring_elytra_appre.name: Soaring-Elytra1
sword_soaring:sword_soaring_elytra_appre.tip: Apprentice-Elytra Double click [%s] to take off. Holding [%s] to speed up.

sword_soaring:sword_soaring_elytra_exper.name: Soaring-Elytra2
sword_soaring:sword_soaring_elytra_exper.tip: Expert-Elytra Double click [%s] to take off. Holding [%s] to speed up.

sword_soaring:sword_soaring_elytra_maste.name: Elytra-Master
sword_soaring:sword_soaring_elytra_maste.tip: You have already been a master, flying will not consume stamina and enter cooldown. Double click [%s] to take off. Holding [%s] to speed up.

sword_soaring:sword_soaring_expert.name: Sword Soaring: Lv2
sword_soaring:sword_soaring_expert.tip: Expert Double click [%s] to take off. Holding [%s] to speed up.

sword_soaring:sword_soaring_master.name: Soaring: Master
sword_soaring:sword_soaring_master.tip: You have already been a master, flying will not consume stamina and enter cooldown. Double click [%s] to take off. Holding [%s] to speed up.

sword_soaring:vatansever_dodge.name: Vatansever Dodge
sword_soaring:vatansever_dodge.tip: Dodge Skill for Vatansever. This skill will be learned automatically when you equip Vatansever. And the skill is invalid when holding other weapon.

sword_soaring:wan_jian_gui_zong.name: Myriad Blades Convergence
sword_soaring:wan_jian_gui_zong.tip: Qi commands the Eight Directions, Blades dominate Six Realms' foundations. Soaring qi summons thousand-edge storm, Focused will merges myriad blades' form. Peak sword dao - mysteries unfold, Only enlightened may this art behold. Cooldown: %.1fs press [%s]

wom:adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
wom:adrenaline.tip: While under 20% Health, gain adrenanline wich will increase your damage by 60% and decrease the damage recieved by 40%

wom:agony_plunge.name: Sky dive
wom:agony_plunge.tip: "Disappear in the sky before diving on your enemies." Attacking enemies will charge this for up to 3 times. The Final damage is multiplied by the number of charges

wom:all_eyes_on_me.name: All Eyes on Me
wom:all_eyes_on_me.tip: dealing damage with 8 different attack will trigger "look - at - me". look - at - me : Regenerate your health, stamina and innate power moderably over 4 sec however, performing action during that time will cancel that effect.

wom:all_eyes_on_you.name: All Eyes on You
wom:all_eyes_on_you.tip: Blocking or dodging 4 different attack will trigger "And watch over you". And watch over you : Regenerate your stamina and innate power slowly over 8 sec.

wom:aqua_maneuvre.name: Aqua maneuver
wom:aqua_maneuvre.tip: Improve swiming ability. Swim faster under water or a little less faster above water. Release jump button to propel under water or butterfly swim above water.

wom:arrow_tenacity.name: Arrow tenacity
wom:arrow_tenacity.tip: Prevent the stun from arrows damage. This skill is permanent, thus you can use another passive on top of it but, you'll only keep the current passive if you die.

wom:avatar_of_might.name: Avatar of Might
wom:avatar_of_might.tip: Holding sneak for 2 sec will release a chockwave that pushes enemy away and grant you with Stun immunity for a short period.

wom:back_and_forth.name: Back and ... FORTH !
wom:back_and_forth.tip: Allow you to blackout your target after reaching a certain distance from it. Attack your target once then move away from it. Once the distance beetween you and your target is greater than 20,your next dash attack will be a strong stun that blackout your target for 5sec.

wom:bull_charge.name: Ravanger force
wom:bull_charge.tip: Charge forward pushing away any entity that come across your path. You are immune to stun effect during the charge and take 40% less damage

wom:buster_parade.name: Dread full buster
wom:buster_parade.tip: Windup your weapon for 1 to 2s, then, release a powerfull attack that bypass guard and cause blackout if the target was blocking or attacking. Available Weapon Types : %s

wom:charybdis.name: Charybdis into Scylla
wom:charybdis.tip: Consume Stamina to perform a whirlwind of hit for a total of 8 strikes. Reduce the stamina consumption with sweeping edge.

wom:counter_attack.name: Counter attack
wom:counter_attack.tip: Perfect Guard will trigger a counter attack based on weapons attacks. Available Weapon Types : %s

wom:critical_knowledge.name: Critical knowledge
wom:critical_knowledge.tip: Give you %s% chance to deal %s% more damage. Critical chance is increased with Fire protection. Critical damage is increased with Blast protection

wom:dancing_blade.name: Dancing blade
wom:dancing_blade.tip: "Dance on the sound of death" Gain 80% damage on every 4th successfull attack.

wom:demonic_ascension.name: Demonic Ascension
wom:demonic_ascension.tip: "The scythe takes possession of your body and use it to perform terrible things...." Ascenscion : on a large area, try to Apply Wither effect before applying 50% catharsis* on affected entity. In Demon form: Base Duration is equal to 20s x (1 + (Sweeping edge level) / 3). Dash attack have twice the chance to apply wither effect but will consume more and more health if used multiple times. Other attacks will cause 80% Catharsis* on withered entitys if they hit. *Catharsis: Reap of the wither effect from the target dealing the remaining damage depending on the catharsis percentage at once and heal you for the remaining of that percentage. catharsis also increase the Demon form duration depending on their wither state (+3s for wither II and +6s for wither III).

wom:dodge_master.name: Dodge master
wom:dodge_master.tip: Instinctly dodge a small distance if you would take damage after the cast within a window of 0.30s. Continuesly dodge all attack after the first one within a window of 0.50s and after each succesful dodge. Double stamina consumption on multiple cast.

wom:dopamine.name: Dopamine
wom:dopamine.tip: Convert the damage dealt with a dash attack into stamina. Afterward, get in cooldown for 4sec.

wom:ender_blast.name: Ender blast
wom:ender_blast.tip: "The zenith of the End world technological power." The blaster loader is composed of 12 chambers. Kinetic energy is stored in them and transmuted into endpower. When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower is condensed into end bullets. The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision. All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

wom:ender_fusion.name: Ender fusion
wom:ender_fusion.tip: "The zenith of the End world technological power." Two blaster loader with 12 chambers each for 24 in Total. the Kinetic energy stored is shared between both Blasters and transmuted into endpower for each. When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower is condensed into end bullets. The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision. All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

wom:ender_obscuris.name: Ender obscuris
wom:ender_obscuris.tip: Teleport you behind the last hitted target within 30 blocks (in radius from your position). While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

wom:ender_step.name: Ender step
wom:ender_step.tip: A fast teleportion away from the danger. While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

wom:flash_mutilation.name: Flash mutilation
wom:flash_mutilation.tip: Teleport yourself around a target before performing a spin attack.

wom:heart_shield.name: Heart shield
wom:heart_shield.tip: Give you 20 shield point that will recover if no action is performed for %ssec at the rate of 1 point every %ssec. Shield recovery rate can be improved with Protection enchantment.

wom:inner_growth.name: Inner Growth
wom:inner_growth.tip: Regenerate 2.0 innate power per second. (+0.1 per Lvl of blast protection) Currently: %s /s

wom:latent_retribution.name: Latent retribution
wom:latent_retribution.tip: If no action is performed within 4 sec, your next action will trigger "Retribution". Retribution : For 4 sec, gives stun immunity and increase your attack by 40%.

wom:lethal_focus.name: Lethal Focus
wom:lethal_focus.tip: Each instance of damage will increase your damage by %s% until it reaches %s%. If no action is performed within 2sec, the damage will decrease rapidly. Damage addup is increased with Fire protection. Damage max is increased with blast protection lvl.

wom:lunar_eclipse.name: Lunar Eclipse
wom:lunar_eclipse.tip: "Moonlight shadowing the night" Strike foes in front of you and makes them glow for 7sec. In Recto : - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage and increase their Glowing lvl. - Attaking Blind targets, stack your damage and remove their Blindness. In Verso: - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage and remove their Glowing. - Attaking Blind targets, increase their Blindness lvl Recto Jump attack ( Crescent ) Unleash all stacked damage on the target. If it kills the target, it bounce to the closest target and loose 5% of its damage. Glowing increase the bounce range. Blindness increase the damage. Verso Jump attack ( Fullmoon ) Unleash 70% of the stacked damage in Aoe. Blindness increase the damage.

wom:lunatic_vivacity.name: Lunatic Vivacity
wom:lunatic_vivacity.tip: Cycle between 2 phase while facing a target. [Lunatic Rush] Decrease your stamina consumption by 85%. Not facing target will stop the timer but not grant any stamina reduction. [Lunatic Linger] Increase your stamina consumption by 85%. Facing a target will double the speed of the timer.

wom:manipulator.name: Manipulator
wom:manipulator.tip: Blocking an attack will grant you stamina based on the timming of the block and your missing stamina. Perfect block = 60% missing stamina Regular block = 0~30% missing stamina

wom:meditation.name: Meditation
wom:meditation.tip: Sneak for 2 second without moving to enter in state of meditation. the longer you meditate the longer the buff. There is 3 stage of meditation each giving different effect: Stage 1: 40% damage dealing. Stage 2: 30% attack speed and Movement speed I Stage 3: 50% damage reduction and Regeneration I

wom:mindset.name: Mindset
wom:mindset.tip: While above 80% Health, gain mindest which will increase your damage by 30% and decrease the damage recieved by 20%

wom:natural_sprinter.name: Natural Sprinter
wom:natural_sprinter.tip: Improve running ability. While [HOLDING] your sprint key for 1 sec, burst into a faster sprinting motion. Releasing sprint button will perform a [Burst step]: - Short Boost forward at the cost of stamina. Jumping while spritting will lunch you further and slightly higher. Sneaking while sprinting will allow you to slide into 1 block gap.

wom:orbital_beam.name: Orbital beam
wom:orbital_beam.tip: Call an orbital beam that strike foes in your gaze.

wom:pain_anticipation.name: Pain anticipation
wom:pain_anticipation.tip: If no action is performed within 2 sec, your next action will trigger "Anticipation". Anticipation : For 2 sec, gives stun immunity and decrease damage recieved by 40%.

wom:perfect_bulwark.name: Perfect bulwark
wom:perfect_bulwark.tip: Holding Guard stance will block attacks from all directions at low progressive stamina cost. Releasing guard after being hit 5 times will send a shockwave that pushes enemys away. Available Weapon Types : %s

wom:plunder_perdition.name: Ender Ritual
wom:plunder_perdition.tip: "Own the ancient arcane of the endermen." When triggering this skill, you can choose between 4 different type of actions: - in neutral and rather close to target, you'll do an [Ender Assault] while alternating between left swing and right swing. - While sprinting, you will do an [Ender Assault] and, if the attack connect, trigger positive [Ender Snatch]. - While rising in the air, you will trigger aerian [Ender Assault] and, trigger negative [Ender Snatch]. - While sneaking and with 10 stored stack, you'll summon Ender Hands under targets around you. Then the hands grasps their respective targets, Damagind them and inflicting them with mining fatigue and slowness. [Ender Assault] - Teleport you around your target depending on the direction you are look at. [Ender Snatch] -

wom:precise_roll.name: Precise roll
wom:precise_roll.tip: Faster, further and cheaper roll. Perform acrobatic Roll like a true expert.

wom:proximity_exploiter.name: Proximity Exploiter
wom:proximity_exploiter.tip: For each living things within 5 blocks of you, regenerate 3 innate power every 0.5s sec.

wom:punishment_kick.name: Punishment kick
wom:punishment_kick.tip: Kick in front of you with force. Cause strong Stun and can blackout if perform during enemy attack.

wom:rechargement.name: Rechargement
wom:rechargement.tip: "Il n'y a que deux puissances au monde, le sabre et l'esprit : à la longue, le sabre est toujours vaincu par l'esprit." After attacking performing skill will reload ammunition depending on the attack made before it. - 1 ammo after first attack. - 2 ammo after the second attacks. - 3 ammo afer the third one. The last attack of the normal combo will also realod 3 ammo. To shoot your ammo, you must perform an attack or a reload first. You can also shoot right after sprinting or if you are rising in the air (jumping). Dealing damage with a shot will increase [Heatdrive] depending on the bullet type. [Heatdrive] slowly decrease if no shot damage is dealt within 4 sec. When fully charged, [Heatdrive] become [Souldrive]: during that state, the drive will quickly decrease but, every second during that state will reload 1 ammo. Ammo can be overcharged if rechargement is performed when 6 ammo is allready loaded. Overcharged Ammo deal more damage and bypass guards. Reloading to reach exactly 6 ammo or 6 overcharged ammo will double the reload ammount for as long as you keep your reloads to reach exactly 6.

wom:regierung.name: Regierung
wom:regierung.tip: "Unbreakable defense combined with overwhelming offense rules over battle." On cast, you'll perform shield attacks in front of you. There is 3 Basic attacks, 1 Dash attack and 1 Jump attack for both the sword and the shield. Some attacks (shields or sword attacks) will move your in front of you. While this occure, the shield will have a slight red field around it as an indicator. During this short period,you will block incoming attacks and perform an automatic counter attack. Depending on how you block an attack, you will increase you Shield Charges by a certain amount. (increased with sweeping edge lvl) Shield Charges can be stored for up to 90 and used in 2 ways: - With the Shield, by holding guard and casting a shield attack. You will convert all Shield charge into shield Overcharge, granting you damage resistance. - With the Sword, by holding guard and casting a sword attack. You will charge your sword and consume your shield charges slowly to perform a spin attack. While your shield is Overcharged, your shield attack will do increase damage after a sword attack based on the Overcharge amount. Getting damaged reduce your Shield Overcharge by 5. ( Sweeping edge on your Sword reduce this by 1 per level )

wom:sakura_state.name: Sakura state
wom:sakura_state.tip: "Sharpest blade forged in absolute serenity" On cast, you'll perform a Sakura slash. Sakura slashes can be declined in 2 form - while sprinting, you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you, slashing them along the way. - while sprinting, (cost 2 stack) you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you, slashing them along the way. - while standing or walking, (cost 1 stack) you'll fastly slash in front of you. Sakura slashes automaticaly sheath your blade afterward. You can stack a total of 12 sakura slashes and Sweeping edge on your blade will grant you extra stack depending on the amount of stack you have on the first cast. ([initial amont of stack] * 1/3 of the sweeping edge levels) After the innitial draw, you'll enter sakura state. If you don't draw a Sakura slash again within 4 seconds, you loose all your stacks and get out of sakura state. Slashing a target with a Dash attack or a Sakura slash, will stack Perpetual slashes on the target. (3 on dashes and sakura slash. 6 on sakura dash slash this value is then multiply by 1/3 of the Sweeping edge lvl). If no action is performed for a set of time after landing perpetual slashes, All Perpetual slashes stacked on the target are triggered, slashing it in sequence for each stacks of Perpetual slashes

wom:shadow_step.name: Shadow step
wom:shadow_step.tip: Sink in the shadows. Moving in the shadow will twist space to make you move faster than the light itself. While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

wom:shooting_style.name: Shooting Style
wom:shooting_style.tip: When empty handed, holding sneak while attacking will do kicks. The combo contain 3 different kick.

wom:shulker_cloak.name: Shulker cloak
wom:shulker_cloak.tip: Loose the ability to guard. Every 5 sec, You gain one level of shulker resistance. If you have at least 1 level of Shulker resistance, you will negate 60% of damage. Getting damaged reduce the level by 1.

wom:solar_arcano.name: Solar Arcano
wom:solar_arcano.tip: "Witness the full force of a star" After each basic attack, a special icon will apear within a short period. Press the Skill button when you see it to perform a timed Solar attack. Solar attack cycle between ignites ( Polvora ) and explode ( Chispear ): Polvora : set the target in fire. if target is allready in fire, increase ignitions level by 1. (can only go up to 2) Chispear: if target is in fire, extinguish the fire and explode for a set of damage depending on the ignitions level. (3 => 6 => 9, +1 per sweeping edge lvl) Solar have a unique skill meter mechanique. Heat level, wich is showed by the percentage number on the skill, can change color (from red to white) depending on the Heating speed. Increase Heat level by increasing heating speed above the orange lvl by successfully performing Chispear. The heating speed increase depends on the target ignition level. Hold guard and press skill to perform Solar Brasero. Solar Brasero harvest heat level to perform incendiary spell: Obscuridad: Infuse your blade with soul fire, melting it into a new form. All attacks within this form trigger Chispear. Lock your heating speed to red. Crematorio: breath soul fire in front of you. Burns targets to ignitions level 3. Durations depends on the amount of time they stay in the flame. Infierno: Burn target around you in a spherical shape. The area of effect will keep growing until 10 sec. Every 2sec, target within the area are affected by polvora. (can increase ignition level to 3) During infierno, all the speed at wich heat level is affected is doubled.

wom:soul_protection.name: Soul protection
wom:soul_protection.tip: Loose the ability to guard. Each second you summon a soul that give 1% damage negation. Your own soul give you 20% damage negation. Getting damaged will remove 3 souls.

wom:spider_techniques.name: Spider techniques
wom:spider_techniques.tip: Allow you to run on walls. Hold sprint and jump toward a wall to run on it. Release sprint to fall or release movement input to slide slowly. Sneak to reduce the slide fall even more. You can jump from a wall to another by adjusting horizontal view angle. The position you jump from will adjust the hight of the wall jump.

wom:time_travel.name: Time travel
wom:time_travel.tip: Register your position and health on cast. After 5sec you'll be teleported back to your previus position and half of all damage taken within this time is healed. Cast again to teleport early or sneak to cancel.

wom:true_berserk.name: True Wrath
wom:true_berserk.tip: "May the god fear you..." Torment wrath makes the skill gauge unreadable.

wom:unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
wom:unbreakable.tip: Give you 3 charge of protection that grant you resistance and stun immunity uppon taking damage. Lose a charge when taking damage.

wom:vampirize.name: Essence Extortion
wom:vampirize.tip: You heal yourself by 20% of the damage you deal.

wom:vengeful_parry.name: Vengeful parry
wom:vengeful_parry.tip: Put you in a guarding stance for 2sec. You will hold your position during that time blocking all attack at no stamina cost. After that you'll be able to send back all the damage in your next attack. Refresh damage on recast. 1sec cooldown. Available Weapon Types : %s

wom:voodoo_magic.name: Voodoo magic
wom:voodoo_magic.tip: Loosing Health increase Stamina by half, Loosing Stamina increase Health by half. Sneak to transfer health into stamina at double rate. Disable stamina auto recovery.

mdvlcraft:wukong_dodge.name: Wukong Dodge
mdvlcraft:wukong_dodge.tip: Sun Wukong's dodge: a quick leap in the direction you are moving. Evades all incoming attacks.
